Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Adamu ciarĩ Sethi, na Enoshu,
English: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

Kikuyu: na Kenani, na Mahalaleli, na Jaredi,
English: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

Kikuyu: na Enoku, na Methusela, na Lameku, na Nuhu.
English: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Nuhu maarĩ: Shemu, na Hamu, na Jafethu.
English: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Jafethu maarĩ: Gomeri, na Magogu, na Madai, na Javani, na Tubali, na Mesheki, na Tirasi.
English: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Gomeri maarĩ: Ashikenazu, na Difatha, na Togarima.
English: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Javani maarĩ: Elisha, na Tarishishi, na Kitimu, na Rodanimu.
English: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Hamu maarĩ: Kushi, na Miziraimu, na Putu, na Kaanani.
English: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Kushi maarĩ: Seba, na Havila, na Sabita, na Raama, na Sabiteka. Ariũ a Raama maarĩ: Sheba, na Dedani.
English: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

Kikuyu: Kushi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Nimurodi ũrĩa wakũrire agĩtuĩka njamba ya ita ĩrĩ hinya thĩinĩ wa thĩ.
English: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

Kikuyu: Miziraimu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa andũ a Ludimu, na Anamini, na Lehabimu, na Nafituhimu,
English: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

Kikuyu: na Pathirusimu, na Kasuluhimu (nĩwe warĩ kĩhumo kĩa Afilisti), o na Kafitorimu.
English: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

Kikuyu: Kaanani nĩwe warĩ ithe wa
English: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

Kikuyu: Sidoni, mũriũ wake wa irigithathi, na Ahiti, na Ajebusi, na Aamori, na Agirigashi,
English: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

Kikuyu: na Ahivi, na Aariki, na Asini,
English: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

Kikuyu: na Aarivadi, na Azemari, na Ahamathi.
English: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Shemu maarĩ: Elamu, na Ashuri, na Arafakasadi, na Ludu, na Aramu. Ariũ a Aramu maarĩ: Uzu, na Hulu, na Getheru, na Mesheki.
English: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

Kikuyu: Arafakasadi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Shela, nake Shela aarĩ ithe wa Eberi.
English: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

Kikuyu: Eberi aarĩ na ariũ eerĩ: Ũmwe eetagwo Pelegu, tondũ hĩndĩ yake nĩrĩo thĩ yagayũkanirio; na mũrũ wa nyina eetagwo Jokitani.
English: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

Kikuyu: Jokitani nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Alimodadi, na Shelefu, na Hazarimavethu, na Jera,
English: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

Kikuyu: na Hadoramu, na Uzali, na Dikila,
English: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

Kikuyu: na Ebali, na Abimaeli, na Sheba,
English: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

Kikuyu: na Ofiri, na Havila, na Jobabu. Acio othe maarĩ ariũ a Jokitani.
English: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

Kikuyu: Shemu, na Arafakasadi, na Shela,
English: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

Kikuyu: na Eberi, na Pelegu, na Reu,
English: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

Kikuyu: na Serugu, na Nahoru, na Tera,
English: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

Kikuyu: na Aburamu (na nĩwe Iburahĩmu).
English: Abram (also called Abraham).

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Iburahĩmu maarĩ: Isaaka na Ishumaeli.
English: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

Kikuyu: Ici nĩcio njiaro ciao: Nebaiothu nĩwe warĩ irigithathi rĩa Ishumaeli, nao ariũ ake arĩa angĩ maarĩ Kedari, na Adibeeli, na Mibisamu,
English: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

Kikuyu: na Mishima, na Duma, na Masa, na Hadadi, na Tema,
English: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

Kikuyu: na Jeturu, na Nafishu, na Kedema. Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Ishumaeli.
English: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Ketura, ũrĩa warĩ thuriya ya Iburahĩmu, maarĩ: Zimirani, na Jokishani, na Medani, na Midiani, na Ishibaku, na Shua. Ariũ a Jokishani maarĩ: Sheba na Dedani.
English: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Midiani maarĩ: Efa, na Eferi, na Hanoku, na Abida, na Elidaa. Acio othe maarĩ a rũciaro rwa Ketura.
English: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

Kikuyu: Iburahĩmu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Isaaka. Ariũ a Isaaka maarĩ: Esaũ na Isiraeli.
English: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Esaũ maarĩ: Elifazu, na Reueli, na Jeushu, na Jalamu, na Kora.
English: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Elifazu maarĩ: Temani, na Omari, na Zefi, na Gatamu, na Kenazu; na Amaleki, ũrĩa waciarirwo nĩ Timina.
English: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Reueli maarĩ: Nahathu, na Zera, na Shama, na Miza.
English: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Seiru maarĩ: Lotani, na Shobali, na Zibeoni, na Ana, na Dishoni, na Ezeri, na Dishani.
English: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Lotani maarĩ: Hori na Homamu. Nake Timina aarĩ mwarĩ wa nyina na Lotani.
English: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Shobali maarĩ: Alivani, na Manahathu, na Ebali, na Shefo, na Onamu. Ariũ a Zibeoni maarĩ: Aia na Ana.
English: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Ana aarĩ: Dishoni. Ariũ a Dishoni maarĩ: Hemudani, na Eshibani, na Ithirani, na Kerani.
English: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Ezeri maarĩ: Bilihani, na Zaavani, na Akani. Ariũ a Dishani maarĩ: Uzu, na Arani.
English: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

Kikuyu: Nao aya nĩo maarĩ athamaki arĩa maathamakaga Edomu mbere ya Isiraeli gũthamakĩrwo nĩ mũthamaki o na ũmwe: Nĩ Bela mũrũ wa Beori, narĩo itũũra rĩake inene rĩetagwo Dinihaba.
English: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Bela aakuire, Jobabu mũrũ wa Zera wa kuuma Bozira agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
English: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jobabu aakuire, Hushamu wa kuuma bũrũri wa Atemani agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
English: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Hushamu aakuire, Hadadi mũrũ wa Bedadi ũrĩa wahootire Midiani kũu bũrũri wa Moabi, agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake. Itũũra rĩake inene rĩetagwo Avithu.
English: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Hadadi aakuire, Samala wa kuuma Masereka agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
English: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Samala aakuire, Shauli wa kuuma Rehobothu kũu gũkuhĩ na Rũũĩ rwa Farati, agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
English: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Shauli aakuire, Baali-Hanani mũrũ wa Akibori agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
English: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Baali-Hanani aakuire, Hadadi agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake. Itũũra rĩake inene rĩetagwo Pau, na mũtumia wake eetagwo Mehetabeli mwarĩ wa Matiredi, ũrĩa warĩ mwarĩ wa Me-Zahabu.
English: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

Kikuyu: Hadadi o nake agĩkua. Anene a Edomu maarĩ:
English: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

Kikuyu: Timina, na Aliva, na Jethethu, na Oholibama, na Ela, na Pinoni,
English: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

Kikuyu: na Kenazu, na Temani, na Mibizaru,
English: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

Kikuyu: na Magidieli, na Iramu. Acio nĩo maarĩ anene a Edomu.
English: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

Kikuyu: Aya nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Isiraeli: Rubeni, na Simeoni, na Lawi, na Juda, na Isakaru, na Zebuluni,
English: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

Kikuyu: na Dani, na Jusufu, na Benjamini, na Nafitali, na Gadi, na Asheri.
English: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Juda maarĩ: Eri, na Onani, na Shela. Acio atatũ maaciarĩirwo Juda nĩ mũtumia Mũkaanani, mwarĩ wa Shua. Eri, irigithathi rĩa Juda, aarĩ mwaganu maitho-inĩ ma Jehova; nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova akĩmũũraga.
English: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s† sight; and he killed him.

Kikuyu: Tamaru, mũtumia wa mũrũ wa Juda, akĩmũciarĩra Perezu na Zera. Ariũ othe a Juda maarĩ atano.
English: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Perezu maarĩ: Hezironi na Hamula.
English: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Zera maarĩ: Zimuri, na Ethani, na Hemani, na Kalikoli, na Darida; othe maarĩ atano.
English: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Karimi aarĩ: Akaru, ũrĩa wareheire Isiraeli thĩĩna nĩ ũndũ wa kuuna watho na kuoya indo iria ciarĩ nyamũre.
English: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Ethani aarĩ: Azaria.
English: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ arĩa maaciarĩrĩirwo Hezironi maarĩ: Jerameeli, na Ramu, na Kalebu.
English: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

Kikuyu: Ramu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Aminadabu, nake Aminadabu aarĩ ithe wa Nahashoni, ũrĩa warĩ mũtongoria wa andũ a Juda.
English: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

Kikuyu: Nahashoni nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Salimoni, nake Salimoni aarĩ ithe wa Boazu,
English: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

Kikuyu: nake Boazu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Obedi, ũria warĩ ithe wa Jesii.
English: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

Kikuyu: Jesii nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Eliabu, irigithathi rĩake; nake Abinadabu aarĩ wa keerĩ, na Shimea wa gatatũ,
English: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

Kikuyu: na Nethaneli wa kana, nake Radai wa gatano,
English: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

Kikuyu: na Ozemu wa gatandatũ, nake Daudi aarĩ wa mũgwanja.
English: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

Kikuyu: Nao aarĩ a nyina maarĩ Zeruia na Abigaili. Ariũ a Zeruia maarĩ atatũ, na nĩo Abishai, na Joabu, na Asaheli.
English: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

Kikuyu: Abigaili nĩwe warĩ nyina wa Amasa, na ithe wa Amasa aarĩ Jetheri ũrĩa Mũishumaeli.
English: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

Kikuyu: Kalebu mũrũ wa Hezironi nĩagĩire ciana na mũtumia wake Azuba (o na ningĩ na Jeriothu). Ariũ a mũtumia ũcio maarĩ: Jesheri, na Shobabu, na Aridoni.
English: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Azuba aakuire, Kalebu akĩhikia Efiratha, ũrĩa wamũciarĩire Huru.
English: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

Kikuyu: Huru nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Uri, nake Uri nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Bezaleli.
English: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

Kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio, Hezironi agĩkoma na mwarĩ wa Makiru ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Gileadi (Hezironi aarĩ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtandatũ akĩmũhikia), nake akĩmũciarĩra Segubu.
English: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

Kikuyu: Segubu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Jairu, ũrĩa warĩ na matũũra mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na matatũ kũu Gileadi.
English: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

Kikuyu: (No rĩrĩ, Geshuru na Aramu magĩtunyana matũũra ma Havothu-Jairu, o hamwe na Kenathu na ciikaro iria ciarĩthiũrũrũkĩirie, namo maarĩ matũũra mĩrongo ĩtandatũ.) Aya othe nĩo maarĩ njiaro cia Makiru, o we ithe wa Gileadi.
English: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

Kikuyu: Thuutha wa Hezironi gũkua arĩ kũu Kalebu-Efiratha-rĩ, Abija mũtumia wa Hezironi akĩmũciarĩra Ashuru, ithe wa Tekoa.
English: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Jerameeli, ũrĩa warĩ irigithathi rĩa Hezironi, maarĩ: Ramu ũrĩa warĩ irigithathi rĩake, na Buna, na Oreni, na Ozemu, na Ahija.
English: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

Kikuyu: Jerameeli aarĩ na mũtumia ũngĩ wetagwo Atara, nake nĩwe warĩ nyina wa Onamu.
English: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Ramu, ũrĩa warĩ irigithathi rĩa Jerameeli, maarĩ: Maazu, na Jamini, na Ekeri.
English: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Onamu maarĩ: Shamai na Jada. Nao ariũ a Shamai maarĩ: Nadabu na Abishuri.
English: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

Kikuyu: Mũtumia wa Abishuri eetagwo Abihaili, ũrĩa wamũciarĩire Ahabani na Molidi.
English: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Nadabu maarĩ: Seledi na Apaimu. No rĩrĩ, Seledi aakuire atarĩ na ciana.
English: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

Kikuyu: Mũrũ wa Apaimu aarĩ: Ishi, ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Sheshani. Nake Sheshani nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ahalai.
English: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Jada, mũrũ wa nyina na Shamai, maarĩ: Jetheri na Jonathani. Jetheri aakuire atarĩ na ciana.
English: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Jonathani maarĩ: Pelethu na Zaza. Acio nĩo maarĩ njiaro cia Jerameeli.
English: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

Kikuyu: Sheshani ndaarĩ na aanake, no airĩtu. Aarĩ na ndungata ya kuuma Misiri yetagwo Jariha.
English: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

Kikuyu: Sheshani akĩhe Jariha ndungata ĩyo yake mwarĩ ĩmũhikie, nake akĩgĩa mwana wetagwo Atai.
English: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

Kikuyu: Atai nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Nathani, nake Nathani nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Zabadi,
English: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

Kikuyu: nake Zabadi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Efilali, nake Efilali nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Obedi,
English: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

Kikuyu: nake Obedi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Jehu, nake Jehu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Azaria,
English: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

Kikuyu: nake Azaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Helezu, nake Helezu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Eleasa,
English: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

Kikuyu: nake Eleasa nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Sisimai, nake Sisimai nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Shalumu,
English: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

Kikuyu: nake Shalumu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Jekamia, nake Jekamia nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Elishama.
English: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Kalebu, ũrĩa warĩ mũrũ wa nyina na Jerameeli, maarĩ: Mesha irigithathi rĩake, na nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Zifu, na mũriũ Maresha ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Hebironi.
English: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Hebironi maarĩ: Kora, na Tapua, na Rekemu, na Shema.
English: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

Kikuyu: Shema nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Rahamu, na Rahamu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Jorikeamu. Rekemu aarĩ ithe wa Shamai.
English: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

Kikuyu: Mũrũ wa Shamai aarĩ Maoni, nake nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Bethi-Zuru.
English: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

Kikuyu: Nake Efa, thuriya ya Kalebu, nĩwe warĩ nyina wa Harani, na Moza, na Gazezi. Nake Harani nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Gazezi.
English: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Jahadai maarĩ: Regemu, na Jothamu, na Geshani, na Peleti, na Efa, na Shaafu.
English: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

Kikuyu: Nake Maaka, thuriya ya Kalebu, nĩwe warĩ nyina wa Sheberi na Tirihana.
English: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ nowe waciarire Shaafu ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Madimana, na Sheva ithe wa Makibena na Gibea. Mwarĩ wa Kalebu eetagwo Akisa.
English: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

Kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarĩ njiaro cia Kalebu. Ariũ a Huru, irigithathi rĩa Efiratha, maarĩ: Shobali ithe wa Kiriathu-Jearimu,
English: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

Kikuyu: na Salima ithe wa Bethilehemu, na Harefu ithe wa Bethi- Gaderi.
English: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Shobali, ithe wa Kiriathu-Jearimu, ciarĩ: Haroe, na nuthu ya Amanahathi,
English: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

Kikuyu: na mĩhĩrĩga ya Kiriathu-Jearimu ĩrĩa yatariĩ ta ũũ: Aithiri, na Aputhi, na Ashumathi, na Amishirai. Kuuma kũrĩ acio gũkĩgĩa njiaro cia Azorathi na Aeshitaoli.
English: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Salima ciarĩ: Bethilehemu ũrĩa Mũnetofathi, na Aatirothu-Bethi-Joabu, na nuthu ya Amanahathi, na Azori,
English: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

Kikuyu: na mĩhĩrĩga ya aandĩki-marũa arĩa maatũũraga Jabezu ĩrĩa yatariĩ ta ũũ: Atirathi, na Ashimeathi, na Asukathi. Aya nĩo Akeni arĩa moimĩte harĩ Hamathu, ithe wa nyũmba ya Rekabu.
English: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

Kikuyu: Aya nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Daudi arĩa maaciarĩirwo Hebironi: Irigithathi rĩarĩ Amunoni mũrũ wa Ahinoamu wa kuuma Jezireeli; nake wa keerĩ aarĩ Danieli mũrũ wa Abigaili wa kuuma Karimeli;
English: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

Kikuyu: nake wa gatatũ aarĩ Abisalomu mũrũ wa Maaka mwarĩ wa Talimai mũthamaki wa Geshuru; nake wa kana aarĩ Adonija mũrũ wa Hagithu;
English: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

Kikuyu: nake wa gatano aarĩ Shefatia mũrũ wa Abitali; nake wa gatandatũ aarĩ Ithireamu ũrĩa aaciarĩirwo nĩ mũtumia wake Egila.
English: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

Kikuyu: Acio atandatũ maaciarĩirwo Daudi kũu Hebironi, kũrĩa aathamakĩire mĩaka mũgwanja na mĩeri ĩtandatũ. Daudi aathamakire arĩ Jerusalemu mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ĩtatũ,
English: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

Kikuyu: nacio ici nĩcio ciana ciake iria ciaciarĩirwo kũu: Shimea, na Shobabu, na Nathani, na Solomoni. Acio ana maaciarirwo nĩ Bathisheba mwarĩ wa Amieli.
English: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

Kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩ kwarĩ na Ibiharu, na Elishua, na Elifeleti,
English: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

Kikuyu: na Noga, na Nefegu, na Jafia,
English: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

Kikuyu: na Elishama, na Eliada, na Elifeleti; othe maarĩ kenda.
English: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

Kikuyu: Acio othe maarĩ ariũ a Daudi, ariũ a thuriya ciake matatarĩtwo. Nake Tamaru nĩwe warĩ mwarĩ wa ithe wao.
English: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Solomoni eetagwo Rehoboamu, nake mũriũ eetagwo Abija, nake Asa aarĩ mũriũ wa Abija, nake Jehoshafatu aarĩ mũriũ wa Asa,
English: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

Kikuyu: nake Jehoramu aarĩ mũriũ wa Jehoshafatu, nake Ahazia aarĩ mũriũ wa Jehoramu, nake Joashu aarĩ mũriũ wa Ahazia,
English: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

Kikuyu: nake Amazia aarĩ mũriũ wa Joashu, nake Azaria aarĩ mũriũ wa Amazia, nake Jothamu aarĩ mũriũ wa Azaria,
English: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

Kikuyu: nake Ahazu aarĩ mũriũ wa Jothamu, nake Hezekia aarĩ mũriũ wa Ahazu, nake Manase aarĩ mũriũ wa Hezekia,
English: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

Kikuyu: nake Amoni aarĩ mũriũ wa Manase, nake Josia aarĩ mũriũ wa Amoni.
English: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Josia maarĩ: Johanani irigithathi rĩake, nake wa keerĩ aarĩ Jehoiakimu, nake wa gatatũ aarĩ Zedekia, nake wa kana aarĩ Shalumu.
English: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

Kikuyu: Arĩa maathamakire thuutha wa Jehoiakimu maarĩ: mũriũ Jekonia na Zedekia.
English: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Jekonia, ũrĩa watahĩtwo, ciarĩ: Mũriũ Shealitieli,
English: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

Kikuyu: na Malikiramu, na Pedaia, na Shenazaru, na Jekamia, na Hoshama, na Nedabia.
English: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Pedaia maarĩ: Zerubabeli na Shimei. Ariũ a Zerubabeli maarĩ: Meshulamu na Hanania; Shelomithu aarĩ mwarĩ wa nyina wao.
English: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

Kikuyu: Nĩ kwarĩ na ariũ angĩ atano, nao nĩ: Hashuba, na Oheli, na Berekia, na Hasadia, na Jushabu-Hesedi.
English: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Hanania ciarĩ: Pelatia, na Jeshaia, na ningĩ nĩ kwarĩ na ariũ a Rafaia, na a Arinani, na a Obadia, o na a Shekania.
English: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Shekania ciarĩ: Shemaia na ariũ ake: Hatushu, na Igali, na Baria, na Nearia, na Shafati; othe maarĩ atandatũ.
English: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Nearia maarĩ: Elioenai, na Hizikia, na Azirikamu; othe maarĩ atatũ.
English: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Elioenai maarĩ: Hodavia, na Eliashibu, na Pelaia, na Akubu, na Johanani, na Delaia, na Anani; othe maarĩ mũgwanja.
English: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Juda ciarĩ: Perezu, na Hezironi, na Karimi, na Huru, na Shobali.
English: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

Kikuyu: Reaia mũrũ wa Shobali nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Jahathu, nake Jahathu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ahumai na Lahadi. Icio nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Azorathi.
English: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Etamu maarĩ: Jezireeli, na Ishima, na Idibasha. Mwarĩ wa nyina wao eetagwo Hazeleliponi.
English: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

Kikuyu: Penueli nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Gedori, nake Ezeri nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Husha. Ici nĩcio ciarĩ njiaro cia Huru ũrĩa irigithathi rĩa Efiratha, na ithe wa Bethilehemu.
English: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

Kikuyu: Ashuri ithe wa Tekoa aarĩ na atumia eerĩ, nĩo Hela na Naara.
English: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

Kikuyu: Naara akĩmũciarĩra Ahuzamu, na Heferi, na Temeni, na Haahashatari. Icio nĩcio ciarĩ njiaro cia Naara.
English: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Hela maarĩ: Zerethi, na Zoharu, na Ethinani,
English: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

Kikuyu: na Kozu, ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Anubu, na Hazobeba, na wa mĩhĩrĩga ya Ahariheli mũrũ wa Harumu.
English: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

Kikuyu: Jabezu aarĩ mũtĩĩku mũno gũkĩra ariũ a nyina. Nyina nĩwe wamũtuire Jabezu, tondũ oigire atĩrĩ, “Ndaamũciarire na ruo.”
English: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez,† saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jabezu agĩkaĩra Ngai wa Isiraeli, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Naarĩ korwo wandathima na ũnjaramĩrie mĩhaka ya bũrũri wakwa! Reke guoko gwaku gũkorwo hamwe na niĩ, na ũngitĩre harĩ ũũru nĩguo ndikanakorwo na ruo.” Nake Ngai akĩigua ihooya rĩake. *
English: Jabez called on the God‡ of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

Kikuyu: Kelubu, mũrũ wa nyina na Shuha, nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Mehiru, ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Eshitoni.
English: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

Kikuyu: Eshitoni nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Bethi-Rafa, na Pasea, na Tehina ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Iri-Nahashu. Acio nĩo maarĩ andũ a Reka.
English: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Kenazu maarĩ: Othinieli na Seraia. Ariũ a Othinieli maarĩ: Hathathu, na Meonothai.
English: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.§

Kikuyu: Meonothai nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ofara. Seraia nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Joabu ũrĩa ithe wa andũ a Ge-Harashimu. Gwetagwo ũguo nĩ ũndũ andũ akuo maarĩ mabundi.
English: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Kalebu, mũrũ wa Jefune, maarĩ: Iru, na Ela, na Naamu. Mũriũ wa Ela eetagwo: Kenazu.
English: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Jehaleleli maarĩ: Zifu, na Zifa, na Tiria, na Asareli.
English: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Ezara maarĩ: Jetheru, na Meredi, na Eferi, na Jaloni. Mũtumia ũmwe wa Meredi nĩwe waciarire Miriamu, na Shamai, na Ishiba ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Eshitemoa.
English: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

Kikuyu: (Mũtumia wake wa kuuma Judea agĩciara Jeredi ũrĩa ithe wa Gedori, na Heberi ithe wa Soko, na Jekuthieli ithe wa Zanoa.) Acio nĩo maarĩ ciana cia Bithia mwarĩ wa Firaũni ũrĩa wahikĩtio nĩ Meredi.
English: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a mũtumia wa Hodia (mwarĩ wa nyina na Nahamu) maarĩ: Ithe wa Keila ũrĩa Mũgarimi, na Eshitemoa ũrĩa Mũmaakathi.
English: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Shimoni maarĩ: Amunoni, na Rina, na Beni-Hanani, na Tiloni. Njiaro cia Ishi nĩ: Zohethu na Beni-Zohethu.
English: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

Kikuyu: Nao ariũ a Shela mũrũ wa Juda maarĩ: Eri ithe wa Leka, na Laada ithe wa Maresha, na mbarĩ cia arĩa maathondekaga gatani ĩrĩa njega† kũuBethi-Ashibea,
English: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

Kikuyu: naJokimu, naandũaKozeba, naJoashunaSarafiarĩamaathanagabũrũri wa Moabi, na Jashubi-Lehemu. (Ũhoro ũyũ ũrutĩtwo maandĩko-inĩ ma tene mũno.)
English: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

Kikuyu: Acio nĩo moombaga indo cia rĩũmba, nao maatũũraga Netaimu na Gedera; maikaraga kũu, marutagĩre mũthamaki wĩra.
English: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Simeoni nĩ: Nemueli, na Jamini, na Jaribu, na Zera, na Shauli;
English: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

Kikuyu: Shalumu aarĩ mũriũ wa Shauli, nake Mibisamu aarĩ mũriũ wa Shalumu, nake Mishima aarĩ mũriũ wa Mibisamu.
English: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Mishima ciarĩ: Mũriũ Hamueli, na Zakuri mũriũ wa Hamueli, na Shimei mũriũ wa Zakuri.
English: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

Kikuyu: Shimei aarĩ na ariũ ikũmi na atandatũ na airĩtu atandatũ, no ariũ a nyina matiarĩ na ciana nyingĩ; nĩ ũndũ ũcio mbarĩ yao ndĩongererekire ta ya andũ a Juda.
English: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

Kikuyu: Nao maatũũraga Birishiba, na Molada, na Hazari-Shuali,
English: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

Kikuyu: na Biliha, na Ezemu, na Toladi,
English: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

Kikuyu: na Bethueli, na Horoma, na Zikilagi,
English: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

Kikuyu: na Bethi-Marikabothu, na Hazari-Susimu, na Bethi-Biri, na Shaaraimu. Macio nĩmo maarĩ matũũra mao nginya rĩrĩa Daudi aathamakaga.
English: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

Kikuyu: Matũũra matano marĩa maamarigiicĩirie maarĩ: Etamu, na Aini, na Rimoni, na Tokenina Ashani,
English: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

Kikuyu: na tũtũũra tũnini tũrĩa twarigiicĩirie matũũra macio o nginya Baalathu. Macio nĩmo maarĩ ũtũũro wao. Nao nĩmaigaga maandĩko ma njiarwa.
English: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

Kikuyu: Meshobabu, na Jamuleki, na Josha mũrũ wa Amazia,
English: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

Kikuyu: na Joeli; na Jehu mũrũ wa Joshibia, mũrũ wa Seraia, mũrũ wa Asieli;
English: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

Kikuyu: o na Elioenai, na Jaakoba, na Jeshohaia, na Asaia, na Adieli, na Jesimieli, na Benaia;
English: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

Kikuyu: na Ziza mũrũ wa Shifi, mũrũ wa Aloni, mũrũ wa Jedaia, mũrũ wa Shimuri, mũrũ wa Shemaia.
English: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

Kikuyu: Andũ acio marĩĩtwa mao magwetetwo hau igũrũ nĩo maarĩ atongoria a mbarĩ ciao. Nyũmba ciao nĩciongererekire mũno,
English: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

Kikuyu: nao magĩthiĩ mĩhaka-inĩ ya Gedori mwena wa irathĩro wa gĩtuamba kĩu gũcaria ũrĩithio wa mahiũ mao.
English: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

Kikuyu: Nĩmoonire kũndũ kũnoru kũrĩ ũrĩithio mwega, bũrũri warĩ mwariĩ, ũrĩ na thayũ na ũkahoorera. Na rĩrĩ, andũ a Hamu‡ amwe nĩo maatũũraga kuo mbere.
English: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

Kikuyu: Andũ arĩa marĩĩtwa mao maandĩkĩtwo mookĩte kuo matukũ-inĩ ma Hezekia mũthamaki wa Juda. Nao magĩtharĩkĩra andũ a Hamu ciikaro-inĩ cia andũ acio o na cia Ameunimu arĩa maatũũraga kuo, na makĩmaniina biũ o ta ũrĩa gũtariĩ nginya ũmũthĩ. Nao magĩtũũra ciikaro-inĩ cia andũ acio tondũ kwarĩ na ũrĩithio mwega wa mahiũ mao.
English: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

Kikuyu: Nao andũ magana matano a nyũmba ya Simeoni, matongoretio nĩ Pelatia, na Nearia, na Refaia na Uzieli, ariũ a Ishi, magĩtharĩkĩra bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma wa Seiru.
English: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

Kikuyu: Nao makĩũraga Aamaleki arĩa meetharĩte magatigara, nao matũire kuo nginya ũmũthĩ.
English: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Rubeni ũrĩa irigithathi rĩa Isiraeli (nĩwe warĩ irigithathi, no rĩrĩa aathaahirie ũrĩrĩ wa ithe, ũrigithathi wake waheirwo ariũ a Jusufu mũrũ wa Isiraeli; nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ndangĩandĩkirwo maandĩko- inĩ ma njiarwa kũringana na ũrigithathi wake,
English: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

Kikuyu: o na gũtuĩka Juda nĩwe warĩ hinya gũkĩra ariũ a ithe, na mũtongoria oimĩte gwake-rĩ, ũrigithathi watuĩkire wa Jusufu);
English: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—

Kikuyu: ariũ a Rubeni, irigithathi rĩa Isiraeli, maarĩ: Hanoku, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi.
English: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Joeli ciarĩ: Mũriũ Shemaia, na mũriũ Gogu, na mũriũ Shimei,
English: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

Kikuyu: na mũriũ Mika, na mũriũ Reaia, na mũriũ Baali,
English: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

Kikuyu: na mũriũ Beera, ũrĩa watahirwo agĩthaamio nĩ Tigilathu-Pileseru mũthamaki wa Ashuri. Beera nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wa andũ a Rubeni.
English: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

Kikuyu: Andũ ao kũringana na mbarĩ ciao, mandĩkĩtwo kũringana na maandĩko ma njiarwa ciao maarĩ aya: Jeieli ũrĩa mũnene, na Zekaria,
English: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

Kikuyu: na Bela mũrũ wa Azazi, mũrũ wa Shema, mũrũ wa Joeli. Maatũũraga rũgongo rũrĩa ruumĩte Aroeri nginya Nebo na Baali-Meoni.
English: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

Kikuyu: Maikarire bũrũri mwena wa irathĩro nginya rũteere-inĩ rwa werũ ũrĩa ũtambũrũkĩte nginya Rũũĩ rwa Farati, tondũ mahiũ mao nĩmaingĩhire mũno marĩ kũu Gileadi.
English: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ya wathani wa Saũlũ nĩmarũire na Ahagari,* na makĩmahoota; nao makĩĩnyiitĩra ciikaro cia Ahagari acio rũgongo-inĩ ruothe rwa mwena wa irathĩro wa Gileadi.
English: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

Kikuyu: Nao andũ a Gadi maatũũire mariganĩtie na andũ a Rubeni kũu bũrũri wa Bashani,† o nginya Saleka:
English: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

Kikuyu: Joeli nĩwe warĩ mũnene kũu Bashani, mũnini wake aarĩ Shafamu, akarũmĩrĩrwo nĩ Janai, na Shafati.
English: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

Kikuyu: Andũ ao kũringana na nyũmba ciao maarĩ: Mikaeli, na Meshulamu, na Sheba, na Jorai, na Jakani, na Zia, na Eberi, othe maarĩ andũ mũgwanja.
English: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

Kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Abihaili mũrũ wa Huru, mũrũ wa Jaroa, mũrũ wa Gileadi, mũrũ wa Mikaeli, mũrũ wa Jeshishai, mũrũ wa Jahido, mũrũ wa Buzi.
English: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

Kikuyu: Ahi mũrũ wa Abidieli, mũrũ wa Guni nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wa nyũmba yao.
English: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

Kikuyu: Nao andũ a Gadi maatũũraga Gileadi, kũu Bashani na matũũra-inĩ marĩa maakuhĩrĩirie kuo, o na kũrĩa guothe ũrĩithio wa Sharoni wakinyĩte.
English: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

Kikuyu: Ũhoro ũyũ wothe nĩ wandĩkirwo maandĩko-inĩ ma njiarwa ciao hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Jothamu mũthamaki wa Juda na Jeroboamu mũthamaki wa Isiraeli maathamakaga.
English: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

Kikuyu: Andũ a Rubeni, na a Gadi, na nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase, maarĩ na andũ 44,760 mehaarĩirie gũthiĩ mbaara-inĩ: andũ marĩ na hinya wa mwĩrĩ, na mangĩahotire kũhũthĩra ngo, na rũhiũ rwa njora, na mooĩ gũikia mĩguĩ na ũta, na maarutĩtwo kũrũa mbaara.
English: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

Kikuyu: Nao makĩhithũkĩra Ahagari, na Ajeturi, na Anafishi, na Anodabu.
English: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

Kikuyu: Nĩmateithirio kũmahũũra, nake Ngai akĩneana Ahagari moko-inĩ mao, marĩ hamwe na arĩa othe maamateithagia, tondũ nĩmamũkaĩire marĩ mbaara-inĩ. Nĩamacookeirie mahooya mao, nĩ ũndũ nĩmamwĩhokete.
English: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

Kikuyu: Magĩtaha mahiũ ma Ahagari acio: ngamĩĩra 50,000, na ngʼondu 250,000, na ndigiri 2,000, ningĩ nĩmatahire andũ 100,000,
English: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

Kikuyu: na angĩ aingĩ makĩũragwo, tondũ Ngai nĩwe wamarũagĩrĩra. Nao magĩikara bũrũri ũcio o nginya hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maatahirwo rĩngĩ.
English: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

Kikuyu: Andũ a nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase maarĩ aingĩ mũno; maatũũrire bũrũri ũcio kuuma Bashani nginya Baali-Herimoni, ũguo nĩ kuuga nginya Seniru (nĩkĩo Kĩrĩma kĩa Herimoni).
English: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

Kikuyu: Aya nĩo maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao: Eferi, na Ishi, na Elieli, na Azirieli, na Jeremia, na Hodavia, na Jahadieli. Maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao, na njamba cia ita, na andũ marĩ igweta.
English: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

Kikuyu: No matiarĩ ehokeku harĩ Ngai wa maithe mao, tondũ nĩmeheanĩte kũrĩ ngai cia andũ a bũrũri ũcio, arĩa Ngai aaniinĩte mehere mbere yao.
English: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Ngai wa Isiraeli akĩarahũra roho wa Puli mũthamaki wa Ashuri (ũguo nĩ kuuga Tigilathu-Pileseru, mũthamaki wa Ashuri), ũrĩa watahire andũ a Rubeni, na andũ a Gadi, na nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase, akĩmatwara ithaamĩrio. Akĩmathaamĩria Hala, na Habori, na Hara, na rũũĩ-inĩ rwa Gozani, kũrĩa matũire nginya ũmũthĩ.
English: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Lawi maarĩ: Gerishoni, na Kohathu, na Merari.
English: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Kohathu maarĩ: Amuramu, na Iziharu, na Hebironi, na Uzieli.
English: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

Kikuyu: Ciana cia Amuramu ciarĩ: Harũni, na Musa, na Miriamu. Ariũ a Harũni maarĩ: Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazaru, na Ithamaru.
English: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

Kikuyu: Eleazaru nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Finehasi, na Finehasi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Abishua,
English: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

Kikuyu: na Abishua nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Buki, na Buki nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Uzi,
English: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

Kikuyu: na Uzi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Zerahia, na Zerahia nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Meraiothu,
English: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

Kikuyu: na Meraiothu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Amaria, na Amaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ahitubu,
English: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

Kikuyu: na Ahitubu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Zadoku, na Zadoku nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ahimaazu,
English: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

Kikuyu: na Ahimaazu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Azaria, na Azaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Johanani,
English: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

Kikuyu: na Johanani nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Azaria (ũrĩa watungataga arĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ĩrĩa Solomoni aakire kũu Jerusalemu),
English: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

Kikuyu: na Azaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Amaria, na Amaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ahitubu,
English: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

Kikuyu: na Ahitubu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Zadoku, na Zadoku nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Shalumu,
English: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

Kikuyu: na Shalumu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Hilikia, na Hilikia nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Azaria,
English: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

Kikuyu: na Azaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Seraia, na Seraia nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Jehozadaku.
English: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

Kikuyu: Jehozadaku nĩathaamirio hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Jehova aarekereirie andũ a Juda na a Jerusalemu matahwo nĩ Nebukadinezaru.
English: Jehozadak went into captivity when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Lawi maarĩ: Gerishoni, na Kohathu, na Merari.
English: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

Kikuyu: Maya nĩmo marĩĩtwa ma ariũ a Gerishoni: Libini na Shimei.
English: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Kohathu maarĩ: Amuramu, na Iziharu, na Hebironi, na Uzieli.
English: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Merari maarĩ: Mahili na Mushi. Icio nĩcio mbarĩ cia Alawii ciandĩkĩtwo kũringana na maithe mao:
English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Gerishoni maarĩ: mũriũ Libini, nake Jehathu aarĩ mũriũ wa Libini, nake Zima aarĩ mũriũ wa Jehathu,
English: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

Kikuyu: nake Joa aarĩ mũriũ wa Zima, nake Ido aarĩ mũriũ wa Joa, nake Zera aarĩ mũriũ wa Ido, nake Jeatherai aarĩ mũriũ wa Zera.
English: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Kohathu ciarĩ: mũriũ Aminadabu, nake Kora aarĩ mũriũ wa Aminadabu, nake Asiru aarĩ mũriũ wa Kora,
English: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

Kikuyu: nake Elikana aarĩ mũriũ wa Asiru, nake Ebiasafu aarĩ mũriũ wa Elikana, nake Asiru aarĩ mũriũ wa Ebiasafu,
English: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

Kikuyu: nake Tahathu aarĩ mũriũ wa Asiru, nake Urieli aarĩ mũriũ wa Tahathu, nake Uzia aarĩ mũriũ wa Urieli, nake Shauli aarĩ mũriũ wa Uzia.
English: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Elikana ciarĩ: Amasai na Ahimothu,
English: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

Kikuyu: nake mũriũ aarĩ Elikana, nake Zofai aarĩ mũriũ wa Elikana, nake Nahathu aarĩ mũriũ wa Zofai,
English: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

Kikuyu: nake Eliabu aarĩ mũriũ wa Nahathu, nake Jerohamu aarĩ mũriũ wa Eliabu, nake Elikana aarĩ mũriũ wa Jerohamu, nake Samũeli aarĩ mũriũ wa Elikana.
English: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Samũeli maarĩ: Joeli irigithathi, na mũriũ wa keerĩ aarĩ Abija.
English: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Merari ciarĩ: Mahili, nake mũriũ aarĩ Libini, nake Shimei aarĩ mũriũ wa Libini, nake Uza aarĩ mũriũ wa Shimei,
English: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

Kikuyu: nake Shimea aarĩ mũriũ wa Uza, nake Hagia aarĩ mũriũ wa Shimea, nake Asaia aarĩ mũriũ wa Hagia.
English: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

Kikuyu: Aya nĩo andũ arĩa Daudi aatuire arũgamĩrĩri a ũini nyũmba-inĩ ya Jehova thuutha wa ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro gũkinya kũu.
English: These are they whom David set over the service of song in Yahweh’s house after the ark came to rest there.

Kikuyu: Maatungataga na ũini Hema-inĩ-ya-Gũtũnganwo o nginya rĩrĩa Solomoni aakire hekarũ ya Jehova kũu Jerusalemu. Nao maarutaga wĩra wao kũringana na mawatho marĩa maatuĩtwo.
English: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

Kikuyu: Aya nĩo andũ arĩa maarutaga wĩra, hamwe na ariũ ao: Kuuma kũrĩ Akohathu maarĩ: Hemani ũrĩa mũini, mũrũ wa Joeli, mũrũ wa Samũeli,
English: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Elikana, mũrũ wa Jerohamu, mũrũ wa Elieli, mũrũ wa Toa,
English: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Zufu, mũrũ wa Elikana, mũrũ wa Mahathu mũrũ wa Amasai,
English: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Elikana, mũrũ wa Joeli, mũrũ wa Azaria, mũrũ wa Zefania,
English: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Tahathu, mũrũ wa Asiru, mũrũ wa Ebiasafu, mũrũ wa Kora,
English: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Iziharu, mũrũ wa Kohathu, mũrũ wa Lawi, mũrũ wa Isiraeli;
English: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

Kikuyu: na Asafu, mũthiritũ wa Hemani, ũrĩa watungataga mwena wake wa ũrĩo: Asafu aarĩ mũrũ wa Berekia, mũrũ wa Shimea,
English: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Mikaeli, mũrũ wa Baaseia, mũrũ wa Malikija
English: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Ethini, mũrũ wa Zera, mũrũ wa Adaia,
English: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Ethani, mũrũ wa Zima, mũrũ wa Shimei,
English: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Jahathu, mũrũ wa Gerishoni, mũrũ wa Lawi;
English: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

Kikuyu: na kuuma kũrĩ athiritũ ao, Amerari, arĩa maatungataga marĩ mwena wake wa ũmotho, maarĩ: Ethani mũrũ wa Kishi, mũrũ wa Abudi, mũrũ wa Maluku,
English: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Hashabia, mũrũ wa Amazia, mũrũ wa Hilikia,
English: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Amuzi, mũrũ wa Bani, mũrũ wa Shemeri,
English: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

Kikuyu: mũrũ wa Mahali, mũrũ wa Mushi, mũrũ wa Merari, mũrũ wa Lawi.
English: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

Kikuyu: Alawii arĩa maarĩ a thiritũ yao maagaĩirwo mawĩra marĩa mangĩ mothe ma hema ĩrĩa nyamũre, o ĩyo nyũmba ya Ngai.
English: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

Kikuyu: No Harũni na njiaro ciake nĩo maarutaga magongona kĩgongona-inĩ kĩa igongona rĩa njino, na kĩgongona-inĩ gĩa gũcinĩrwo ũbumba, na wĩra wothe warutagwo ũkonainie na Handũ-hau-Hatheru-Mũno, nĩ ũndũ wa kũhoroheria andũ a Isiraeli mehia, kũringana na ũrĩa Musa ndungata ya Ngai yaathanĩte.
English: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

Kikuyu: Ici nĩcio njiaro cia Harũni: Mũriũ aarĩ Eliazaru, nake mũriũ wake aarĩ Finehasi, nake Abishua aarĩ mũriũ wa Finehasi,
English: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

Kikuyu: nake Buki aarĩ mũriũ wa Abishua, nake Uzi aarĩ mũriũ wa Buki, nake Zerahia aarĩ mũriũ wa Uzi,
English: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

Kikuyu: nake Meraiothu aarĩ mũriũ wa Zerahia, nake Amaria aarĩ mũriũ wa Meraiothu, nake Ahitubu aarĩ mũriũ wa Amaria,
English: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

Kikuyu: nake Zadoku aarĩ mũriũ wa Ahitubu, nake Ahimaazu aarĩ mũriũ wa Zadoku.
English: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, gũkũ nĩkuo kũndũ kũrĩa maagaĩirwo kũrĩ bũrũri wao (nakuo kwagaĩirwo njiaro cia Harũni iria ciarĩ cia mbarĩ ya Kohathu, tondũ igai rĩa mbere rĩarĩ rĩao):
English: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

Kikuyu: Maaheirwo Hebironi kũu Juda, o hamwe na ũrĩithio ũrĩa warigiicĩirie.
English: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

Kikuyu: No mĩgũnda na matũũra marĩa maakuhĩrĩirie itũũra inene maaheirwo Kalebu mũrũ wa Jefune.
English: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio njiaro cia Harũni ciaheirwo Hebironi (itũũra inene rĩa kũũrĩra) na Libina, na Jatiri, na Eshitemoa,
English: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

Kikuyu: na Hileni, na Debiri,
English: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

Kikuyu: na Ashani, na Juta, na Bethi-Shemeshu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo.
English: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

Kikuyu: Na kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Benjamini maaheirwo Gibeoni, na Geba, na Alemethu, na Anathothu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo. Matũũra marĩa maagaĩirwo mĩhĩrĩga ya Akohathu mothe maarĩ ikũmi na matatũ.
English: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

Kikuyu: Njiaro icio ingĩ cia Kohathu ciaheirwo matũũra ikũmi, kuuma kũrĩ nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase.
English: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Gerishoni, mbarĩ o mbarĩ ciagaĩirwo matũũra ikũmi na matatũ kuuma kũrĩ mũhĩrĩga wa Isakaru, na wa Asheri, na wa Nafitali, na kuuma kũrĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Manase ũrĩa ũrĩ Bashani.
English: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Merari, mbarĩ o mbarĩ, ciagaĩirwo matũũra ikũmi na meerĩ kuuma kũrĩ mũhĩrĩga wa Rubeni, na wa Gadi, na wa Zebuluni.
English: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ a Isiraeli makĩhe Alawii matũũra macio na ũrĩithio wamo.
English: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

Kikuyu: Kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Juda, na wa Simeoni, na wa Benjamini makĩmahe matũũra macio magwetetwo.
English: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

Kikuyu: Mbarĩ imwe cia Akohathu ciaheirwo matũũra nĩ mũhĩrĩga wa Efiraimu matuĩke bũrũri wao.
English: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

Kikuyu: Kuuma bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma wa Efiraimu maaheirwo Shekemu (itũũra rĩa kũũrĩra), na Gezeri,
English: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

Kikuyu: na Jokimeamu, na Bethi-Horoni,
English: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

Kikuyu: na Aijaloni, na Gathi-Rimoni, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo.
English: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

Kikuyu: Na kuuma nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase-rĩ, andũ a Isiraeli makĩheana matũũra ma Aneri na Bileamu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo, kũrĩ mbarĩ iria ingĩ cia Akohathu.
English: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

Kikuyu: Agerishoni maagaĩirwo matũũra maya: Kuuma nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase makĩheo Golani kũu Bashani, o na Ashitarothu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo;
English: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

Kikuyu: Kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Isakaru makĩheo Kadeshi, na Daberathu,
English: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

Kikuyu: na Ramothu, na Anemu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo;
English: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

Kikuyu: Kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Asheri makĩheo Mashali, na Abidoni,
English: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

Kikuyu: na Hukoku, na Rehobu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo;
English: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

Kikuyu: Na kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Nafitali makĩheo Kedeshi kũu Galili, na Hamoni, na Kiriathaimu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo.
English: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

Kikuyu: Amerari (Alawii arĩa angĩ) maagaĩirwo matũũra maya: Kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Zebuluni makĩheo Jokineamu, na Karita, na Rimono, na Taboru, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo;
English: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Rubeni mũrĩmo wa Jorodani mwena wa irathĩro wa Jeriko, makĩheo Bezeri werũ-inĩ, na Jahaza,
English: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

Kikuyu: na Kedemothu, na Mefaathu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo;
English: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

Kikuyu: na kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Gadi makĩheo Ramothu o kũu Gileadi, na Mahanaimu,
English: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

Kikuyu: na Heshiboni, na Jazeri, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo.
English: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Isakaru maarĩ: Tola, na Pua, na Jashubu, na Shimuroni; othe maarĩ ana.
English: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Tola maarĩ: Uzi, na Refaia, na Jerieli, na Jahamai, na Ibisamu, na Shemueli; nao maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao. Hĩndĩ ya wathani wa Daudi, njiaro cia Tola iria ciaandĩkĩtwo maandĩko-inĩ ma njiarwa ciao marĩ andũ a kũrũa mbaara maarĩ 22,600.
English: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Uzi aarĩ: Izirahia. Ariũ a Izirahia maarĩ: Mikaeli, na Obadia, na Joeli, na Ishia. Othe atano maarĩ anene a andũ ao.
English: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

Kikuyu: Kũringana na maandĩko ma njiarwa cia nyũmba ciao, maarĩ na arũme mehaarĩirie kũrũa mbaara 36,000, nĩgũkorwo maarĩ na atumia aingĩ na ciana nyingĩ.
English: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

Kikuyu: Andũ ao arĩa maangĩarũire mbaara kuuma mĩhĩrĩga-inĩ yothe ya Isakaru, kũringana na maandĩko ma njiarwa ciao, maarĩ 87,000 marĩ othe.
English: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

Kikuyu: Ariũ atatũ a Benjamini maarĩ: Bela, na Bekeri, na Jediaeli.
English: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Bela maarĩ: Eziboni, na Uzi, na Uzieli, na Jerimothu, na Iri; othe maarĩ atano, na maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao. Maandĩko ma njiarwa ciao moonanagia arũme a kũrũa mbaara maarĩ 22,034.
English: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Bekeri maarĩ: Zemira, na Joashu, na Eliezeri, na Elioenai, na Omuri, na Jeremothu, na Abija, na Anathothu, na Alemethu. Acio othe maarĩ ariũ a Bekeri.
English: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

Kikuyu: Maandĩko ma njiarwa ciao moonanagia atongoria a nyũmba, na arũme a kũrũa mbaara 20,200.
English: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Jediaeli aarĩ: Bilihani. Ariũ a Bilihani maarĩ: Jeushu, na Benjamini, na Ehudu, na Kenaana, na Zethani, na Tarishishi, na Ahishaharu.
English: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

Kikuyu: Ariũ acio othe a Jediaeli maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao. Nĩ kwarĩ na arũme 17,200 a kũrũa mehaarĩirie gũthiĩ mbaara-inĩ.
English: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

Kikuyu: Nao andũ a Shupimu na a Hupimu maarĩ a rũciaro rwa Iru, nao Ahushimu maarĩ a rũciaro rwa Aheri.
English: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Nafitali maarĩ: Jahazieli, na Guni, na Jezeri, na Shalumu; aya maarĩ a rũciaro rwa Biliha.
English: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Manase ciarĩ: Asirieli, ũrĩa aaciarĩirwo nĩ thuriya yake ĩrĩa yarĩ Mũaramiti. Ningĩ thuriya ĩyo ĩkĩmũciarĩra Makiru, ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Gileadi.
English: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

Kikuyu: Makiru aahikanirie kuuma kwa Ahupimu na Ashupimu. Mwarĩ wa nyina eetagwo Maaka. Ũrĩa ũngĩ wa rũciaro rwake eetagwo Zelofehadi, nake aaciarĩte o airĩtu.
English: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

Kikuyu: Mũtumia wa Makiru, Maaka nĩaciarire mwanake na akĩmũtua Pereshu. Mũrũ wa nyina na Pereshu eetagwo Shereshu, na ariũ a Shereshu maarĩ Ulamu na Rakemu.
English: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Ulamu eetagwo: Bedani. Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Gileadi mũrũ wa Makiru, mũrũ wa Manase.
English: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

Kikuyu: Mwarĩ wa nyina Hamolekethu nĩaciarire Ishihodi, na Abiezeri, na Mahala.
English: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Shemida maarĩ: Ahiani, na Shekemu, na Liki, na Aniamu.
English: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Efiraimu ciarĩ: Shuthela na mũriũ Beredi, na Tahathu mũriũ wa Beredi, na Eleada mũriũ wa Tahathu, na Tahathu mũriũ wa Eleada, na mũriũ Zabadi, na Shuthela mũriũ wa Zabadi,
English: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

Kikuyu: na Zabadi aarĩ mũriũ wa Tahathu, nake Shuthela aarĩ mũriũ wa Zabadi. Ezeri na Eleadi mooragirwo nĩ andũ arĩa maaciarĩirwo Gathi hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maathiĩte gũtaha mahiũ mao.
English: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

Kikuyu: Ithe wao Efiraimu nĩamacakaĩire mĩthenya mĩingĩ, nao andũ ao magĩũka kũmũhooreria.
English: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩkoma na mũtumia wake rĩngĩ, nake akĩgĩa nda agĩciara kahĩĩ. Nake agĩgatua Beria, tondũ nĩ gwakoretwo na mũtino thĩinĩ wa nyũmba yake.
English: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah,† because there was trouble with his house.

Kikuyu: Mwarĩ wa Efiraimu eetagwo Sheera, ũrĩa waakire Bethi-Horoni ya kĩanda na ya rũgongo, na agĩaka Uzeni-Sheera.
English: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

Kikuyu: Refa aarĩ mũriũ wa Efiraimu, na mũriũ eetagwo Resefu, na Tela mũriũ wa Resefu, na Tahani mũriũ wa Tela,
English: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

Kikuyu: na Ladani mũriũ wa Tahani, na Amihudu mũriũ wa Ladani, na Elishama mũriũ wa Amihudu,
English: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

Kikuyu: na Nuni mũriũ wa Elishama, na Joshua mũriũ wa Nuni.
English: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

Kikuyu: Ithaka na ciikaro ciao ciarĩ Betheli, na matũũra marĩa maakũrigiicĩirie, na nĩ Naara mwena wa irathĩro, na Gezeri na matũũra makuo ma mwena wa ithũĩro, na Shekemu na matũũra makuo, nginya Gaza na matũũra makuo.
English: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

Kikuyu: Kũrigania na mĩhaka ya Manase maarĩ na Bathi-Shani, na Taanaka, na Megido, na Dori, hamwe na matũũra makuo. Njiaro cia Jusufu mũrũ wa Isiraeli nĩcio ciaikaraga matũũra macio.
English: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Asheri maarĩ: Imuna, na Ishiva, na Ishivi, na Beria. Mwarĩ wa nyina wao eetagwo Sera.
English: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Beria maarĩ: Heberi na Malikieli ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Birizaithu.
English: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

Kikuyu: Heberi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Jefileti, na Shomeri, na Hothamu, na mwarĩ wa nyina wao eetagwo Shua.
English: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Jafileti maarĩ: Pasaka, na Bimihali, na Ashavathu. Acio maarĩ ariũ a Jefileti.
English: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Shomeri maarĩ: Ahi, na Rohaga, na Jehuba, na Aramu.
English: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a mũrũ wa nyina na Helemu maarĩ: Zofa, na Imuna, na Sheleshu, na Amali.
English: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Zofa maarĩ: Sua, na Harineferi, na Shuali, na Beri, na Imura,
English: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

Kikuyu: na Bezeri, na Hodi, na Shama, na Shilisha, na Ithirani, na Beera.
English: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Jetheri maarĩ: Jefune, na Pisipa, na Ara.
English: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Ula maarĩ: Ara, na Hanieli, na Rizia.
English: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

Kikuyu: Acio othe maarĩ njiaro cia Asheri; nĩo maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao, na andũ athuure, na njamba cia ita, na atongoria arĩa maarĩ igweta. Mũigana wa andũ arĩa maangĩathiire mbaara kũringana na maandĩko ma njiarwa ciao maarĩ 26,000.
English: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

Kikuyu: Benjamini nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Bela, mũriũ wake wa irigithathi; Ashibeli aarĩ mũriũ wa keerĩ, nake Ahara wa gatatũ,
English: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

Kikuyu: nake Noha wa kana, nake Rafa wa gatano.
English: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Bela maarĩ: Adari, na Gera, na Abihudi,
English: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

Kikuyu: na Abishua, na Naamani, na Ahoa,
English: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

Kikuyu: na Gera, na Shefufani, na Huramu.
English: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

Kikuyu: Aya nĩo maarĩ njiaro cia Ehudu, arĩa maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia arĩa maatũũraga Geba, na nĩo maathaamĩirio Manahathu:
English: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

Kikuyu: Naamani, na Ahija, na Gera ũrĩa wamathaamirie, na nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Uza na Ahihudu.
English: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

Kikuyu: Shaharaimu nĩaciarĩirwo ciana kũu Moabi thuutha wa gũte atumia ake Hushimu na Baara.
English: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

Kikuyu: Mũtumia wake Hodeshu akĩmũciarĩra ciana ici: Jobabu, na Zibia, na Mesha, na Malikamu,
English: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

Kikuyu: na Jeuzu, na Shakia, na Mirima. Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ ake, na maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao.
English: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

Kikuyu: Mũtumia wake Hushimu akĩmũciarĩra Ahitubu na Elipaali.
English: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Elipaali maarĩ: Eberi, na Mishamu, na Shemedi (ũrĩa wakire Ono, o na Lodi na matũũra marĩa maakũrigiicĩirie),
English: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

Kikuyu: na Beria, na Shema arĩa maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia arĩa maatũũraga Aijaloni, na nĩo maingatire andũ arĩa maatũũraga Gathu.
English: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

Kikuyu: Ahio, na Shashaka, na Jeremothu,
English: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

Kikuyu: na Zebadia, na Aradi, na Ederi,
English: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

Kikuyu: na Mikaeli, na Ishipa, na Joha maarĩ ariũ a Beria.
English: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

Kikuyu: Zebadia, na Meshulamu, na Hiziki, na Heberi,
English: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

Kikuyu: na Ishimerai, na Izilia, na Jababu maarĩ ariũ a Elipaali.
English: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

Kikuyu: Jakimu, na Zikiri, na Zabedi,
English: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

Kikuyu: na Elienai, na Zilethai, na Elieli,
English: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

Kikuyu: na Adaia, na Beraia, na Shimirathu maarĩ ariũ a Shimei.
English: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

Kikuyu: Ishipani, na Eberi, na Elieli,
English: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

Kikuyu: na Abidoni, na Zikiri, na Hanani,
English: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

Kikuyu: na Hanania, na Elamu, na Anithothija,
English: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

Kikuyu: na Ifĩdeia, na Penueli maarĩ ariũ a Shashaka.
English: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

Kikuyu: Shamusherai, na Sheharia, na Athalia,
English: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

Kikuyu: na Jaareshia, na Elija, na Zikiri maarĩ ariũ a Jerohamu.
English: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

Kikuyu: Aya othe maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba o na anene, ta ũrĩa maandĩkĩtwo maandĩko-inĩ ma njiarwa ciao, na maaikaraga Jerusalemu.
English: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

Kikuyu: Jeieli ithe wa Gibeoni aatũũraga Gibeoni. Mũtumia wake eetagwo Maaka,
English: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

Kikuyu: na mũriũ wake wa irigithathi eetagwo Abidoni, akarũmĩrĩrwo nĩ Zuru, na Kishu, na Baali, na Neri, na Nadabu,
English: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

Kikuyu: na Gedori, na Ahio, na Zekeri,
English: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

Kikuyu: na Mikilothu ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Shimea. O nao maaikaraga hakuhĩ na andũ ao kũu Jerusalemu.
English: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

Kikuyu: Neri aarĩ ithe wa Kishu, nake Kishu aarĩ ithe wa Saũlũ. Saũlũ aarĩ ithe wa Jonathani
English: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Jonathani: eetagwo Meribu-Baali, na nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Mika.
English: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Mika maarĩ: Pithoni, na Meleku, na Tarea, na Ahazu.
English: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

Kikuyu: Ahazu aarĩ ithe wa Jehoada, nake Jehoada aarĩ ithe wa Alemethu, na Azamavethu, na Zimuri; nake Zimuri aarĩ ithe wa Moza.
English: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

Kikuyu: Moza aarĩ ithe wa Binea; nake Rafa aarĩ mũriũ wa Binea, nake Eleasa aarĩ mũriũ wa Rafa, nake Azeli aarĩ mũriũ wa Eleasa.
English: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

Kikuyu: Azeli aarĩ na ariũ atandatũ, na maya nĩmo marĩĩtwa mao: Azirikamu, na Bokeru, na Ishumaeli, na Shearia, na Obadia, na Hanani. Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Azeli.
English: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Esheku, mũrũ wa nyina, maarĩ: Ulamu irigithathi rĩake, na Jeushu wa keerĩ, na Elifeleti wa gatatũ.
English: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Ulamu maarĩ njamba cia ita, na nĩmamenyete gũtũmĩra ũta. Maarĩ na ariũ aingĩ o na ciana cia ciana ciao, na othe maarĩ 150. Acio othe nĩo maarĩ njiaro cia Benjamini.
English: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

Kikuyu: Andũ a Isiraeli othe nĩmandĩkĩtwo maandĩko-inĩ ma njiarwa marĩa maarĩ mbuku-inĩ ya athamaki a Isiraeli. Andũ a Juda nĩmatahĩtwo magatwarwo Babuloni nĩ ũndũ wa kwaga kwĩhokeka.
English: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold,† they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ arĩa maambire gũcooka gũikara mĩgũnda-inĩ yao o kũu matũũra-inĩ mao, maarĩ andũ amwe a Isiraeli, na athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na Alawii, na ndungata cia hekarũ.
English: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

Kikuyu: Andũ arĩa maatũũraga Jerusalemu kuuma Juda, na Benjamini, na Efiraimu, na Manase maarĩ:
English: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

Kikuyu: Uthai mũrũ wa Amihudu, mũrũ wa Omuri, mũrũ wa Imuri, mũrũ wa Bani wa rũciaro rwa Perezu mũrũ wa Juda.
English: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

Kikuyu: Andũ a Shiloni maarĩ: Asaia ũrĩa warĩ irigithathi, na ariũ ake.
English: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

Kikuyu: Kuuma Zera aarĩ: Jeueli. Andũ othe a kuuma Juda maarĩ 690.
English: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

Kikuyu: Andũ a Benjamini maarĩ: Salu mũrũ wa Meshulamu, mũrũ wa Hodavia, mũrũ wa Hasenua;
English: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

Kikuyu: na Ibineia mũrũ wa Jerohamu; Ela mũrũ wa Uzi, mũrũ wa Mikiri; na Meshulamu mũrũ wa Shefatia, mũrũ wa Reueli, mũrũ wa Ibinija.
English: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

Kikuyu: Andũ a kuuma Benjamini, ta ũrĩa maandĩkĩtwo maandĩko-inĩ ma njiarwa ciao, maarĩ 956. Arũme acio othe maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao.
English: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

Kikuyu: Athĩnjĩri-Ngai maarĩ: Jedaia, na Jehoiaribu, na Jakini;
English: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

Kikuyu: na Azaria mũrũ wa Hilikia, mũrũ wa Meshulamu, mũrũ wa Zadoku, mũrũ wa Meraiothu, mũrũ wa Ahitubu ũrĩa warĩ mũmenyereri mũnene wa nyũmba ya Ngai;
English: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

Kikuyu: na Adaia mũrũ wa Jerohamu, mũrũ wa Pashuru, mũrũ wa Malikija; na Maasai mũrũ wa Adieli, mũrũ wa Jahazera, mũrũ wa Meshulamu, mũrũ wa Meshilemithu, mũrũ wa Imeri.
English: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

Kikuyu: Athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao maarĩ 1,760. Maarĩ arũme maarĩ na ũhoti, na nĩ meehokeirwo gũtungata nyũmba-inĩ ya Ngai.
English: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

Kikuyu: Alawii maarĩ: Shemaia mũrũ wa Hashubu, mũrũ wa Azirikamu, mũrũ wa Hashabia ũrĩa Mũmerari,
English: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

Kikuyu: na Bakabakari, na Hereshi, na Galali, na Matania mũrũ wa Mika, mũrũ wa Zikiri, mũrũ wa Asafu;
English: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

Kikuyu: na Obadia mũrũ wa Shemaia, mũrũ wa Galali, mũrũ wa Jeduthuni; na Berekia mũrũ wa Asa, mũrũ wa Elikana, arĩa maaikaraga matũũra-inĩ ma Anetofathi.
English: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

Kikuyu: Arangĩri a ihingo maarĩ: Shalumu, na Akubu, na Talimoni, na Ahimani na ariũ a nyina, na Shalumu mũnene wao,
English: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

Kikuyu: acio maigĩtwo kĩhingo-inĩ kĩa mũthamaki mwena wa irathĩro, nginya ihinda-inĩ rĩu. Acio nĩo maarĩ arangĩri a ihingo a gĩkundi kĩa Alawii.
English: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

Kikuyu: Shalumu mũrũ wa Kore, mũrũ wa Ebiasafu, mũrũ wa Kora, na athiritũ ake arangĩri a ihingo kuuma nyũmba yake ya Akohathu. Acio nĩo meehokeirwo ũrangĩri wa itoonyero rĩa hema o ta ũrĩa maithe mao meehokeirwo ũrangĩri wa itoonyero rĩa Gĩikaro kĩa Jehova.
English: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.

Kikuyu: Mahinda ma mbere Finehasi mũrũ wa Eleazaru nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra arangĩri a ihingo, nake Jehova aarĩ hamwe nake.
English: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.

Kikuyu: Zekaria mũrũ wa Meshelemia nĩwe warĩ mũrangĩri wa itoonyero rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo.
English: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
