English: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, hĩndĩ ya kĩmera yakinya, ihinda rĩrĩa athamaki maathiiaga mbaara, Joabu agĩtongoria mbũtũ cia ita. Nake akĩananga bũrũri wa Aamoni, na agĩthiĩ Raba akĩrĩrigiicĩria, no Daudi agĩtigwo Jerusalemu. Joabu agĩtharĩkĩra Raba agĩtiga aarĩananga.
English: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

Kikuyu: Daudi akĩruta mũthamaki wao thũmbĩ mũtwe, nayo yarĩ na ũritũ wa taranda ĩmwe* ya thahabu, na nĩyagemetio na tũhiga twa goro, nayo ĩkĩigĩrĩrwo mũtwe wa Daudi. Nake agĩtaha indo nyingĩ mũno kuuma itũũra rĩu inene,
English: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold,† and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

Kikuyu: na akĩrutũrũra aikari akuo, akĩmahe wĩra wa gwatũra mbaũ na mĩthumeno, na kũruta wĩra na harũ cia igera na mathanwa. Ũguo nĩguo Daudi eekire matũũra mothe ma Amoni. Thuutha ũcio Daudi na mbũtũ ciake ciothe cia ita magĩcooka Jerusalemu.
English: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

Kikuyu: Mahinda macio-rĩ, gũkĩgĩa mbaara ya kũrũa na Afilisti kũu Gezeri. Hĩndĩ ĩyo Sibekai ũrĩa Mũhushathi akĩũraga Sipai, ũmwe wa njiaro cia Refai, nao Afilisti magĩtoorio biũ.
English: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

Kikuyu: Mbaara-inĩ ĩngĩ makĩrũa na Afilisti, nake Elihanani mũrũ wa Jairu akĩũraga Lahami mũrũ wa nyina na Goliathũ, ũrĩa Mũgiiti, ũrĩa warĩ na itimũ rĩarĩ na mũtĩ waiganaga ta mũtĩ wa mũtumi ngoora.
English: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ mbaara-inĩ ĩngĩ ĩrĩa yarũĩirwo Gathu, kwarĩ na mũndũ mũnene mũno, warĩ na ciara ithathatũ o guoko, na ciara ithathatũ o kũgũrũ, ciothe ciarĩ ciara mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na inya. O nake aarĩ wa rũciaro rwa Rafa.
English: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa aanyũrũririe andũ a Isiraeli, Jonathani mũrũ wa Shimea, mũrũ wa nyina na Daudi, akĩmũũraga.
English: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

Kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarĩ a rũciaro rwa Rafa wa kũu Gathu, nao makĩũragwo nĩ Daudi na andũ ake.
English: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Shaitani nĩookĩrĩire andũ a Isiraeli, na akĩarahũra Daudi nĩguo atarithie andũ a Isiraeli.
English: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi akĩĩra Joabu na anene a mbũtũ cia ita atĩrĩ: “Thiĩi mũgatare andũ a Isiraeli kuuma Birishiba nginya Dani, mũcooke mũndehere ũhoro nĩguo menye ũrĩa maigana.”
English: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

Kikuyu: Nowe Joabu akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Jehova aroingĩhia mbũtũ ciake cia ita maita igana. Mwathi wakwa mũthamaki, githĩ othe matirĩ watho-inĩ waku? Nĩ kĩĩ gĩgũtũma mwathi wakwa ende gwĩka ũguo? Nĩ kĩĩ gĩgũtũma ahĩtithie Isiraeli?”
English: Joab said, “May Yahweh make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mũthamaki agĩkararia Joabu; nĩ ũndũ ũcio Joabu akiuma hau agĩthiĩ Isiraeli guothe, na agĩcooka Jerusalemu.
English: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

Kikuyu: Joabu akĩmenyithia Daudi mũigana wa andũ arĩa maangĩarũire mbaara ta ũũ: Isiraeli guothe kwarĩ na andũ 1,100,000 arĩa maangĩahotire kũhũthĩra rũhiũ rwa njora, thĩinĩ wao haarĩ na andũ 470,000 kuuma Juda.
English: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Joabu ndaatarire andũ a Lawi na a Benjamini, tondũ watho ũcio wa mũthamaki nĩwamũiguithĩtie ũũru mũno.
English: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

Kikuyu: O na ningĩ watho ũcio warĩ mũũru maitho-inĩ ma Ngai; nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩherithia Isiraeli.
English: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Daudi akĩĩra Ngai atĩrĩ, “Nĩnjĩhĩtie mũno nĩ gwĩka ũndũ ũyũ. Rĩu ndagũthaitha ũnjehererie mahĩtia, niĩ ndungata yaku. Nĩnjĩkĩte ũndũ wa ũrimũ mũno.”
English: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Gadi ũrĩa woonagĩra Daudi maũndũ atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

Kikuyu: “Thiĩ ũkeere Daudi ũũ, ‘Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: Ũrĩ na maũndũ matatũ ma gũthuura. Nowe ũthuure ũmwe wamo ũrĩa ngũkũherithia naguo.’ ”
English: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.” ’ ”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Gadi agĩthiĩ kũrĩ Daudi, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Jehova ekuuga ũũ: ‘Thuura ũndũ ũmwe wa maya:
English: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:

Kikuyu: Ũthuure mĩaka ĩtatũ ya ngʼaragu, kana mĩeri ĩtatũ ya kũniinwo nĩ thũ ciaku igũthingatĩte na hiũ ciao cia njora, kana mĩthenya ĩtatũ ya rũhiũ rwa njora rwa Jehova, naguo nĩ atĩ kũgĩe na mĩthenya ya mũthiro bũrũri-inĩ, rĩrĩa mũraika wa Jehova akaaniinana Isiraeli guothe.’ Na rĩrĩ, tua itua ũnjĩĩre ũrĩa ngũthiĩ gũcookeria ũrĩa ũndũmĩte.”
English: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and Yahweh’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’ ”

Kikuyu: Daudi akĩĩra Gadi atĩrĩ, “Rĩu niĩ ndĩ na thĩĩna mũno. Nĩ kaba niĩ ngwe moko-inĩ ma Jehova, tondũ tha ciake nĩ nyingĩ mũno; no ndũkareke ngwe moko-inĩ ma andũ.”
English: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova akĩrehera Isiraeli mũthiro, na andũ a Isiraeli 70,000 magĩkua.
English: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

Kikuyu: Nake Ngai agĩtũma mũraika akanange Jerusalemu. No rĩrĩa mũraika ekaga ũguo-rĩ, Jehova akĩona ũndũ ũcio na akĩigua kĩeha nĩ ũndũ wa kĩnyariirĩko kĩu, nake akĩĩra mũraika ũcio wanangaga andũ atĩrĩ, “Tigĩra hau! Eheria guoko gwaku.” Hĩndĩ ĩyo mũraika ũcio wa Jehova aarũgamĩte kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano kĩa Arauna ũrĩa Mũjebusi.
English: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, Yahweh saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

Kikuyu: Nake Daudi akĩrora igũrũ akĩona mũraika wa Jehova arũngiĩ gatagatĩ ka igũrũ na thĩ acomorete rũhiũ rwa njora, arũnyiitĩte na guoko gwake gũtambũrũkĩirio Jerusalemu. Nake Daudi na athuuri, mehumbĩte nguo cia makũnia, makĩgũa magĩturumithia mothiũ mao thĩ.
English: David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

Kikuyu: Daudi akĩũria Ngai atĩrĩ, “Githĩ ti niĩ ndaathanire atĩ arũi a mbaara matarwo? Niĩ nĩ niĩ njĩhĩtie o na ngeeka ũũru. Andũ aya matariĩ o ta ngʼondu. Nĩ atĩa mekĩte? Wee Jehova Ngai wakwa, reke guoko gwaku kũnjũkĩrĩre niĩ na nyũmba yakwa, no rĩrĩ, ndũkareke mũthiro ũyũ ũikare na andũ aku.”
English: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O Yahweh my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

Kikuyu: Nake mũraika wa Jehova agĩatha Gadi eere Daudi aambate athiĩ agaakĩre Jehova kĩgongona o kũu kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano kĩa Arauna ũrĩa Mũjebusi.
English: Then Yahweh’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi akĩambata agĩathĩkĩra kiugo kĩu Gadi aarĩtie thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova.
English: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in Yahweh’s name.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Arauna aakonyoraga ngano-rĩ, akĩĩhũgũra akĩona mũraika ũcio; nao ariũ ake ana arĩa maarĩ nake makĩĩhitha.
English: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

Kikuyu: Nake Daudi agĩkuhĩrĩria, na rĩrĩa Arauna aarorire akĩmuona, akiuma kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano, akĩinamĩrĩria mũtwe wake mbere ya Daudi, na agĩturumithia ũthiũ thĩ.
English: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

Kikuyu: Daudi akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Njĩtĩkĩria njakĩreJehova kĩgongonahaha kĩhuhĩro-inĩgĩkĩ gĩaku kĩa ngano, nĩguo mũthiro ũyũ ũkorete andũ ũthire. Nyenderia o ũrĩa thogora wakĩo ũigana.”
English: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to Yahweh on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

Kikuyu: Arauna akĩĩra Daudi atĩrĩ, “Kĩoe! Reke mũthamaki mwathi wakwa eeke ũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩmũkenia. Na rĩrĩ, nĩngũkũhe ndegwa ici irutwo igongona rĩa njino, ihũũri ici cia ngano ituĩke ngũ, ngano nayo ĩtuĩke ya igongona rĩa mũtu. Icio ciothe nĩngũkũhe.”
English: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

Kikuyu: Nowe Mũthamaki Daudi agĩcookeria Arauna atĩrĩ, “Aca, no nginya ndĩhe thogora wakĩo ũrĩa ũigana. Ndingĩrutĩra Jehova kĩndũ gĩaku, kana ndute igongona rĩa njino na kĩndũ kĩrĩa itarutĩire thogora.”
English: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for Yahweh, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi akĩrĩha Arauna cekeri magana matandatũ* cia thahabu nĩ ũndũ wa handũ hau.
English: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels† of gold by weight for the place.

Kikuyu: Daudi agĩakĩra Jehova kĩgongona handũ hau, na akĩruta maruta ma njino na maruta ma ũiguano. Agĩkaĩra Jehova, nake Jehova akĩmwĩtĩka na njĩra ya mwaki uumĩte igũrũ, ũgĩakana kĩgongona-inĩ kĩu kĩa maruta ma njino.
English: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on Yahweh; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩarĩria mũraika ũcio nake agĩcookia rũhiũ rwake njora.
English: Then Yahweh commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo, rĩrĩa Daudi onire atĩ Ngai nĩamũiguĩte arĩ kũu kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano kĩa Arauna ũcio Mũjebusi-rĩ, akĩrutĩra magongona hau.
English: At that time, when David saw that Yahweh had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

Kikuyu: Hema ya Jehova ĩrĩa nyamũre ĩrĩa Musa aathondekeire werũ-inĩ, na kĩgongona kĩa maruta ma njino, hĩndĩ ĩyo ciarĩ harĩa hatũũgĩru o kũu Gibeoni.
English: For Yahweh’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Daudi ndangĩathiire mbere yakĩo gũtuĩria ũhoro harĩ Ngai tondũ nĩetigagĩra rũhiũ rwa njora rwa mũraika ũcio wa Jehova.
English: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of Yahweh’s angel.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Daudi akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nyũmba ya Jehova Ngai ĩgaakwo haha, o na kĩgongona gĩa kũrutagĩrwo maruta ma njino nĩ Isiraeli.”
English: Then David said, “This is the house of Yahweh God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi agĩathana atĩ ageni othe arĩa maatũũraga Isiraeli* macookanĩrĩrio, nake agĩthuura kuuma thĩinĩ wao mabundi a mahiga, nĩgeetha mahaarĩrie na maicũhie mahiga ma gwaka nyũmba ya Ngai.
English: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

Kikuyu: Nake akĩruta igera nyingĩ cia gũthondeka mĩcumarĩ ya mĩrango ya ihingo na ya kũnyiitithania indo cia nyũmba thĩinĩ, na gĩcango kĩingĩ gĩtangĩthimĩka.
English: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

Kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩruta mĩgogo ya mĩtarakwa ĩtangĩtarĩka, nĩgũkorwo andũ a Sidoni na a Turo nĩmareheire Daudi mĩgogo mĩingĩ.
English: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

Kikuyu: Daudi akiuga atĩrĩ, “Mũriũ wakwa Solomoni nĩ mwĩthĩ na ndarĩ na ũũgĩ wa kũigana, nayo nyũmba ĩrĩa ĩgwakĩrwo Jehova yagĩrĩirwo nĩgũkorwo ĩrĩ na ũthaka mũnene na ngumo na riiri maitho-inĩ ma ndũrĩrĩ ciothe. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩ ngũhaarĩria mwako wayo.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi akĩhaarĩria maũndũ ma mwako ũcio na njĩra nene atanakua.
English: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩĩta mũriũ Solomoni akĩmwatha aakĩre Jehova Ngai wa Isiraeli nyũmba.
English: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.

Kikuyu: Daudi akĩĩra Solomoni ũũ: “Mũrũ wakwa, ndũire nyendaga gwaka nyũmba ĩtanĩtio na rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova Ngai wakwa.
English: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, kiugo gĩkĩ kĩa Jehova gĩkĩnginyĩrĩra, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ, ‘Wee nĩũitĩte thakame nyingĩ na ũkarũa mbaara nyingĩ. Ndũgwaka nyũmba ĩtanĩtio na rĩĩtwa rĩakwa, nĩ ũndũ nĩũitithĩtie thakame nyingĩ gũkũ thĩ, maitho-inĩ makwa.
English: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

Kikuyu: No nĩũkagĩa na mũriũ ũrĩa ũgaatuĩka mũndũ wa thayũ na wa kũhoorera, na nĩngamũhe ũhurũko kuuma kũrĩ thũ ciake mĩena yothe. Rĩĩtwa rĩake ageetwo Solomoni, na hĩndĩ ya ũthamaki wake nĩngaahe Isiraeli thayũ na ũhurũko.
English: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

Kikuyu: Ũcio nĩwe ũgaaka nyũmba ĩtanĩtio na Rĩĩtwa rĩakwa. Agaatuĩka mũrũ wakwa, na niĩ nduĩke ithe. Ningĩ nĩngahaanda gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene wake kũu Isiraeli nginya tene.’
English: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

Kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, mũrũ wakwa, Jehova aroikara nawe, na ũrogaacĩra na wake nyũmba ya Jehova Ngai waku, ta ũrĩa oigire nĩũgeeka.
English: Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

Kikuyu: Jehova arokũhe ũbaarĩrĩri na ũmenyo rĩrĩa agaakũnengera ũthamaki wa Isiraeli, nĩgeetha ũrũmie watho wa Jehova Ngai waku.
English: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo wee nĩũkagaacĩra, ũngĩgatuĩka wa kũmenyagĩrĩra kĩrĩra kĩa watho wake wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo o na watho ũrĩa Jehova aaheire Musa nĩ ũndũ wa Isiraeli. Gĩa na hinya na ũmĩrĩrie. Ndũgetigĩre kana ũkue ngoro.
English: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

Kikuyu: “Nĩndutĩte wĩra mũnene wa kũhaarĩria mwako wa hekarũ ya Jehova, ngaigithia taranda 100,000† cia thahabu, na taranda 1,000,000‡ cia betha, na icango nyingĩ na igera nyingĩ itangĩthimĩka, na mbaũ na mahiga. Nawe no wongerere ingĩ.
English: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents† of gold, one million talents‡ of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

Kikuyu: Ũrĩ na aruti wĩra aingĩ: aicũhia a mahiga, na aaki a mahiga, na aaki a mbaũ, o hamwe na andũ marĩ na ũũgĩ wa kũruta wĩra o wothe
English: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

Kikuyu: wa thahabu na wa betha, na wa gĩcango na wa igera, na mabundi maingĩ makĩria. Rĩu kĩambĩrĩrie wĩra, nake Jehova aroikara hamwe nawe.”
English: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Daudi agĩatha atongoria othe a Isiraeli mateithie mũriũ Solomoni.
English: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

Kikuyu: Akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Githĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu ndarĩ hamwe na inyuĩ? Na githĩ ndamũheete ũhurũko mĩena yothe? Nĩgũkorwo nĩaneanĩte atũũri a bũrũri ũyũ moko-inĩ makwa, na rĩu bũrũri ũrĩ watho-inĩ wa Jehova na andũ ake.
English: “Isn’t Yahweh your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Yahweh and before his people.

Kikuyu: Rĩu mwĩheanei ngoro na muoyo mũcarie Jehova Ngai wanyu. Ambĩrĩriai gwaka handũ- harĩa-haamũre ha Jehova Ngai, nĩgeetha mũrehe ithandũkũ rĩa Jehova rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro na indo iria nyamũre cia Ngai itoonyio hekarũ ĩrĩa ĩgwakwo nĩ ũndũ wa Rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova.”
English: Now set your heart and your soul to follow Yahweh your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for Yahweh’s name.”

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, rĩrĩa Daudi aakũrire na agĩkorwo arĩ na mĩaka mĩingĩ-rĩ, agĩtua mũriũ Solomoni mũthamaki wa gũthamakĩra Isiraeli.
English: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩcookanĩrĩria atongoria othe a Isiraeli hamwe na athĩnjĩri-Ngai na Alawii.
English: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

Kikuyu: Alawii arĩa maakinyĩtie mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ kana makĩria magĩtarwo, nao arũme othe maarĩ 38,000.
English: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

Kikuyu: Daudi akiuga atĩrĩ, “Thĩinĩ wa aya, 24,000 nĩ marũgamagĩrĩre wĩra wa hekarũ ya Jehova, nao 6,000 matuĩke anene na atuithania a ciira.
English: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

Kikuyu: Nao andũ 4,000 matuĩke arangĩri a ihingo, nao acio angĩ 4,000 matuĩke a kũgoocaga Jehova marĩ na inanda cia ũini iria heanĩte nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra ũcio kĩũmbe.”
English: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

Kikuyu: Daudi nĩagayanirie Alawii acio ikundi kũringana na ariũ a Lawi na nĩo Gerishoni, na Kohathu, na Merari.
English: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Gerishoni maarĩ: Ladani na Shimei.
English: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Ladani maarĩ: Jehieli na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao, na Zethamu, na Joeli; othe maarĩ atatũ.
English: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Shimei maarĩ: Shelomothu, na Hazieli, na Harani, othe maarĩ atatũ. Acio nĩo maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia Ladani.
English: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

Kikuyu: Na ariũ a Shimei maarĩ: Jahathu, na Ziza, na Jeushu, na Beria. Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Shimei; othe maarĩ ana.
English: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

Kikuyu: Jahathu nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao, nake Ziza aarĩ mũnini wake, no Jeushu na Beria matiarĩ na ariũ aingĩ; nĩ ũndũ ũcio maatarirwo ta maarĩ a nyũmba ĩmwe, na makĩheo wĩra ũmwe.
English: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Kohathu maarĩ: Amuramu, na Iziharu, na Hebironi, na Uzieli: othe maarĩ ana.
English: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Amuramu maarĩ: Harũni na Musa. Harũni nĩamũrirwo hamwe na njiaro ciake nginya tene, nĩgeetha maamũrage indo iria theru mũno, na marutagĩre Jehova magongona, na mamũtungatagĩre, na marathimanage thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩake nginya tene.
English: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Musa, mũndũ wa Ngai, maataranĩirio na mũhĩrĩga wa Lawi.
English: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Musa maarĩ: Gerishomu na Eliezeri.
English: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Gerishomu nĩ: Shebueli nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
English: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Eliezeri nĩ: Rehabia na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao. Eliezeri ndaarĩ na ariũ angĩ, no ariũ a Rehabia maarĩ aingĩ mũno.
English: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Iziharu maarĩ: Shelomithu na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
English: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Hebironi maarĩ: Jeria na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao, na Amaria aarĩ wa keerĩ, na Jahazieli aarĩ wa gatatũ, na Jekameamu aarĩ wa kana.
English: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Uzieli maarĩ: Mika na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao, nake Ishia aarĩ mũnini wake.
English: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Merari maarĩ: Mahali na Mushi. Ariũ a Mahali maarĩ: Eleazaru na Kishu.
English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

Kikuyu: Eleazaru aakuire atarĩ na aanake; aarĩ o na airĩtu. Makĩhikio nĩ ariũ a mũrũ wa nyina na ithe wao Kishu.
English: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Mushi maarĩ: Mahali, na Ederi, na Jeremothu; othe maarĩ atatũ.
English: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

Kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarĩ njiaro cia Lawi kũringana na nyũmba ciao: na nĩo maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao ta ũrĩa marĩĩtwa mao maandĩkĩtwo, na maatarirwo mũndũ o mũndũ, ũguo nĩ kuuga aruti a wĩra arĩa maarĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na makĩria, arĩa maatungataga hekarũ-inĩ ya Jehova.
English: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

Kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Daudi nĩoigĩte atĩrĩ, “Kuona atĩ Jehova Ngai wa Isiraeli nĩaheete andũ ake ũhurũko, na nĩokĩte gũtũũra Jerusalemu nginya tene-rĩ,
English: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

Kikuyu: Alawii matigũcooka kũbatario nĩgũkuuaga hema ĩrĩa nyamũre kana kĩndũ o nakĩ kĩa iria ihũthagĩrwo cia gũtungata thĩinĩ wayo.”
English: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

Kikuyu: Kũringana na ciugo cia Daudi cia mũthia, Alawii arĩa maarĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ kana makĩria nĩmatarirwo.
English: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

Kikuyu: Wĩra wa Alawii warĩ wa gũteithia njiaro cia Harũni ũtungata-inĩ wa hekarũ ya Jehova ta ũũ: kũrũgamĩrĩra nja cia hekarũ na tũnyũmba twa ithaku-inĩ, na gũtherithia indo iria nyamũre, na kũruta mawĩra marĩa mangĩ thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya Ngai.
English: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

Kikuyu: Nĩo maarĩ arũgamĩrĩri a mĩgate ĩrĩa yaigagwo metha-inĩ, na maruta ma mũtu wa ngano, na tũmĩgate tũrĩa tũtarĩ na ndawa ya kũimbia, na wĩra wa gũkanda na kũruga mĩgate, na mawĩra mothe ma gũthima ũingĩ na mũigana wa indo.
English: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

Kikuyu: Ningĩ marũgamage o rũciinĩ gũcookeria Jehova ngaatho na kũmũgooca. Ningĩ magekaga ũguo o hwaĩ- inĩ,
English: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;

Kikuyu: na rĩrĩa rĩothe maruta ma njino mangĩarutĩirwo Jehova, mĩthenya ya Thabatũ, na ciathĩ cia Karũgamo ka Mweri, na ciathĩ iria ingĩ ciathanĩtwo. No nginya matungatage mbere ya Jehova mahinda mothe marĩ mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo, ningĩ na njĩra ĩrĩa maathĩtwo marutage nayo.
English: and to offer all burnt offerings to Yahweh on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Yahweh;

Kikuyu: Na nĩ ũndũ ũcio Alawii magĩthiĩ na mbere kũruta wĩra ũrĩa mehokeirwo wa Hema-ya- Gũtũnganwo, na wa Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru, matongoretio nĩ ariũ a ithe wao a rũciaro rwa Harũni, nĩ ũndũ wa ũtungata wa hekarũ ya Jehova.
English: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of Yahweh’s house.

Kikuyu: Ici nĩcio ciarĩ ikundi cia ariũ a Harũni: Ariũ a Harũni maarĩ Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazaru, na Ithamaru.
English: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Nadabu na Abihu nĩmakuire ithe wao atakuĩte, na matiarĩ na ciana cia aanake; nĩ ũndũ ũcio Eleazaru na Ithamaru magĩtungata marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

Kikuyu: Zadoku wa rũciaro rwa Eleazaru na Ahimeleku wa rũciaro rwa Ithamaru nĩo maateithĩrĩirie Daudi kũmagayania ikundi, nĩ ũndũ wa mũtaratara wa ũtungata ũrĩa maathuurĩirwo.
English: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

Kikuyu: Atongoria arĩa aingĩ moimĩte njiaro-inĩ cia Eleazaru gũkĩra arĩa moimĩte njiaro- inĩ cia Ithamaru, nao makĩgayanio ta ũũ: kuuma njiaro-inĩ cia Eleazaru kwarĩ na atongoria a nyũmba ikũmi na atandatũ, na kuuma njiaro-inĩ cia Ithamaru kwarĩ na atongoria a nyũmba anana.
English: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

Kikuyu: Maamagayanirie na kĩhooto na ũndũ wa gũcuuka mĩtĩ, nĩgũkorwo nĩ haarĩ na anene a handũ-harĩa- haamũre, na anene a nyũmba ya Ngai gatagatĩ-inĩ ka njiaro icio cia Eleazaru na cia Ithamaru.
English: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

Kikuyu: Shemaia mũrũ wa Nethaneli, ũrĩa mwandĩki-marũa Mũlawii, nĩandĩkire marĩĩtwa mao arĩ mbere ya mũthamaki na anene aya: Zadoku ũrĩa-mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na Ahimeleku mũrũ wa Abiatharu, na atongoria a nyũmba cia athĩnjĩri-Ngai na cia Alawii. Nyũmba ĩmwe ĩgathuurwo kuuma kũrĩ Eleazaru, na ĩrĩa ĩngĩ ĩgathuurwo kuuma kũrĩ Ithamaru.
English: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

Kikuyu: Mũtĩ wa mbere wagũire kũrĩ Jehoiaribu, na wa keerĩ kũrĩ Jedaia,
English: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

Kikuyu: na wa gatatũ kũrĩ Harimu, na wa kana kũrĩ Seroimu,
English: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

Kikuyu: na wa gatano kũrĩ Malikija, na wa gatandatũ kũrĩ Mijamini,
English: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

Kikuyu: na wa mũgwanja kũrĩ Hakozu, na wa kanana kũrĩ Abija,
English: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

Kikuyu: na wa kenda kũrĩ Jeshua, na wa ikũmi kũrĩ Shekania,
English: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

Kikuyu: na wa ikũmi na ũmwe kũrĩ Eliashibu, na wa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ kũrĩ Jakimu,
English: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

Kikuyu: na wa ikũmi na ĩtatũ kũrĩ Hupa, na wa ikũmi na ĩna kũrĩ Jeshebeabu,
English: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

Kikuyu: na wa ikũmi na ĩtano kũrĩ Biliga, na wa ikũmi na ĩtandatũ kũrĩ Imeri,
English: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

Kikuyu: na wa ikũmi na mũgwanja kũrĩ Heziri, na wa ikũmi na ĩnana kũrĩ Hapizezu,
English: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

Kikuyu: na wa ikũmi na kenda kũrĩ Pethahia, na wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ kũrĩ Jehezekeli,
English: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

Kikuyu: na wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ũmwe kũrĩ Jakini, na wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na igĩrĩ kũrĩ Gamuli,
English: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

Kikuyu: na wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtatũ kũrĩ Delaia, na wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩna kũrĩ Maazia.
English: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

Kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo warĩ mũtaratara wa ũtungata wao rĩrĩa maatoonya hekarũ ya Jehova, kũringana na watho ũrĩa maatuĩrĩirwo nĩ ithe wao Harũni, ta ũrĩa Jehova Ngai wa Isiraeli aamwathĩte.
English: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

Kikuyu: Njiaro iria ingĩ cia Lawi ciarĩ: kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Amuramu: nĩ Shubaeli; na kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Shubaeli: nĩ Jehedeia.
English: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Rehabia: nĩ Ishia na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
English: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Iziharu: nĩ Shelomothu; na kuuma ariũ a Shelomothu: nĩ Jahathu.
English: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Hebironi maarĩ: Jeria na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao, Amaria aarĩ wa keerĩ, nake Jahazieli aarĩ wa gatatũ, na Jekameamu aarĩ wa kana.
English: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

Kikuyu: Mũrũ wa Uzieli: aarĩ Mika; kuuma ariũ a Mika: nĩ Shamiru.
English: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

Kikuyu: Mũrũ wa nyina na Mika: aarĩ Ishia; kuuma ariũ a Ishia: nĩ Zekaria.
English: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Merari: maarĩ Mahali na Mushi. Mũrũ wa Jaazia: aarĩ Beno.
English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Merari: kuuma kũrĩ Jaazia: maarĩ Beno, na Shohamu, na Zakuri, na Ibiri.
English: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

Kikuyu: kuuma kũrĩ Mahali: nĩ Eleazaru, ũrĩa ũtaarĩ na aanake.
English: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ Kishu: nĩ mũriũ Jerameeli.
English: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

Kikuyu: Nao ariũ a Mushi: maarĩ Mahali, na Ederi, na Jeremothu. Acio nĩo maarĩ Alawii kũringana na nyũmba ciao.
English: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

Kikuyu: O nao nĩmacuukire mĩtĩ o ta ũrĩa ariũ a ithe wao a rũciaro rwa Harũni meekire, marĩ mbere ya Mũthamaki Daudi o na mbere ya Zadoku, na Ahimeleku, na atongoria a nyũmba cia athĩnjĩri-Ngai na cia Alawii. Nyũmba cia mũrũ wa nyina ũrĩa mũkũrũ ciekirwo o ta ũrĩa nyũmba cia ũrĩa mũnini mũno ciekirwo.
English: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

Kikuyu: Daudi arĩ hamwe na anene a mbũtũ cia ita nĩamũrire ariũ amwe a Asafu, na Hemani, na Jeduthuni marutage wĩra wa ũrathi makĩhũũraga inanda cia mũgeeto, na cia kĩnũbi, na thaani iria ihũũrithanagio ikagamba. Maya nĩmo marĩĩtwa ma andũ arĩa maarutaga wĩra ũyũ wa kũina:
English: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Asafu: maarĩ Zakuri, na Jusufu, na Nethania, na Asarela. Ariũ a Asafu maarũgamagĩrĩrwo nĩ Asafu, ũrĩa warathaga ũhoro arũgamĩrĩirwo nĩ mũthamaki.
English: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Jeduthuni: maarĩ Gedalia, na Zeri, na Jeshaia, na Shimei, na Hashabia, na Matithia; othe maarĩ atandatũ, marũgamĩrĩirwo nĩ ithe wao Jeduthuni, ũrĩa warathaga ũhoro, akĩhũũraga kĩnanda kĩa mũgeeto, agacookagĩria Jehova ngaatho na akamũgoocaga.
English: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Hemani: maarĩ Bukia, na Matania, na Uzieli, na Shubaeli, na Jerimothu, na Hanania, na Hanani, na Eliatha, na Gidaliti, na Romamuti-Ezeri, na Joshibekasha, na Malothi, na Hothiru, na Mahaziothu.
English: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

Kikuyu: Acio othe maarĩ ariũ a Hemani ũrĩa wonagĩra mũthamaki maũndũ. Maaheanĩtwo kũrĩ we kũringana na ciĩranĩro cia Ngai nĩguo mamũtũũgagĩrie. Ngai aaheete Hemani ariũ ikũmi na ana, na airĩtu atatũ.
English: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

Kikuyu: Andũ aya othe maarũgamagĩrĩrwo nĩ maithe mao nĩguo mainage thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya Jehova, marĩ na thaani iria ihũũrithanagio ikagamba, na inanda cia kĩnũbi, na inanda cia mũgeeto, nĩ ũndũ wa ũtungata wa nyũmba ya Ngai. Asafu, na Jeduthuni, na Hemani nao maarũgamagĩrĩrwo nĩ mũthamaki.
English: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

Kikuyu: Hamwe na andũ a nyũmba ciao, arĩa othe maarutĩtwo na makagĩa na ũũgĩ wa kũinĩra Jehova, othe maarĩ andũ 288.
English: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

Kikuyu: Andũ ethĩ na akũrũ ũndũ ũmwe, na arutani o na arutwo, nĩmacuukire mĩtĩ nĩguo magaĩrwo mawĩra mao.
English: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

Kikuyu: Mũtĩ wa mbere, ũrĩa warĩ wa Asafu, wagwĩrĩire Jusufu, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12; wa keerĩ wagwĩrĩire Gedalia, we na andũ a nyũmba yao, na ariũ ao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

Kikuyu: wa gatatũ wagũĩrĩire Zakuri, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa kana wagũĩrĩire Iziri, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ
English: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: ; 12 wa gatano wagũĩrĩire Nethania, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa gatandatũ wagũĩrĩire Bukia, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa mũgwanja wagũĩrĩire Jesarela, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa kanana wagũĩrĩire Jeshaia, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa kenda wagũĩrĩire Matania, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi wagũĩrĩire Shemei, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi na ũmwe wagũĩrĩire Azareli, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ wagũĩrĩire Hashabia, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi na ĩtatũ wagũĩrĩire Shubaeli, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi na ĩna wagũĩrĩire Matithia, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi na ĩtano wagũĩrĩire Jerimothu, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi na ĩtandatũ wagũĩrĩire Hanania, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi na mũgwanja wagũĩrĩire Joshibekasha, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi na ĩnana wagũĩrĩire Hanani, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa ikũmi na kenda wagũĩrĩire Malothi, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ wagũĩrĩire Eliatha, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ũmwe wagũĩrĩire Hothiru, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩĩrĩ wagũĩrĩire Gidaliti, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtatũ wagũĩrĩire Mahaziothu, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
English: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Kikuyu: wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩna wagũĩrĩire Romamuti-Ezeri, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12.
English: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

Kikuyu: Ikundi cia arangĩri a ihingo: kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Kora maarĩ: Meshelemia mũrũ wa Kore, ũmwe wa ariũ a Asafu.
English: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Meshelemia maarĩ: Zekaria, na nĩwe warĩ wa irigithathi, na Jediaeli aarĩ wa keerĩ, na Zebadia aarĩ wa gatatũ, na Jathinieli aarĩ wa kana,
English: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

Kikuyu: na Elamu aarĩ wa gatano, na Jehohanani aarĩ wa gatandatũ, na Eliehoenai aarĩ wa mũgwanja.
English: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Obedi-Edomu maarĩ: Shemaia, na nĩwe warĩ wa irigithathi, na Jehozabadu aarĩ wa keerĩ, na Joa aarĩ wa gatatũ, na Sakaru aarĩ wa kana, na Nethaneli aarĩ wa gatano,
English: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

Kikuyu: na Amieli aarĩ wa gatandatũ, na Isakaru aarĩ wa mũgwanja, na Peulethai aarĩ wa kanana, nĩgũkorwo Ngai nĩarathimĩte Obedi-Edomu.
English: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ Shemaia o nake aarĩ na ariũ ake, arĩa maarĩ atongoria thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya ithe wao, tondũ maarĩ andũ ehoti.
English: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Shemaia maarĩ: Othini, na Refaeli, na Obedi, na Elizabadu, nao andũ a nyũmba yao, Elihu, na Semakia, maarĩ andũ ehoti.
English: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

Kikuyu: Acio othe maarĩ a njiaro cia Obedi-Edomu; o hamwe na ariũ ao, na andũ a nyũmba yao maarĩ andũ ehoti, na maarĩ na hinya wa kũruta wĩra. Njiaro cia Obedi-Edomu othe maarĩ andũ 62.
English: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

Kikuyu: Meshelemia nĩ aarĩ na ariũ ake na andũ a nyũmba yao, arĩa maarĩ andũ ehoti, othe maarĩ andũ 18.
English: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

Kikuyu: Ariũ a Hosa ũrĩa Mũmerari maarĩ: Shimuri na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao (o na gũtuĩka tiwe warĩ irigithathi, ithe nĩamũthuurĩte atuĩke mũtongoria wao),
English: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

Kikuyu: Hilikia aarĩ wa keerĩ, nake Tabalia aarĩ wa gatatũ, na Zekaria aarĩ wa kana. Ariũ a Hosa na andũ a nyũmba yao othe maarĩ andũ 13.
English: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

Kikuyu: Ikundi icio cia arangĩri a ihingo ciĩtanĩtio na anene ao, ciarĩ na mawĩra ma gũtungata thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya Jehova o ta andũ arĩa angĩ a nyũmba yao.
English: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh’s house.

Kikuyu: Andũ ethĩ na andũ akũrũ o ũndũ ũmwe nĩmacuukĩire o kĩhingo mĩtĩ kũringana na nyũmba ciao.
English: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

Kikuyu: Mũtĩ wa Kĩhingo kĩa Irathĩro wagwĩrĩire Shelemia. Ningĩ magĩcuuka mĩtĩ nĩ ũndũ wa mũriũ Zekaria, ũrĩa warĩ mũheani kĩrĩra mũũgĩ, nake akĩgwĩrwo nĩ mũtĩ wa Kĩhingo gĩa Gathigathini.
English: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

Kikuyu: Mũtĩ wa Kĩhingo gĩa Gũthini wagwĩrĩire Obedi-Edomu, naguo mũtĩ wa nyũmba-ya-kũigwo-indo ũkĩgwĩra ariũ ake.
English: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

Kikuyu: Mĩtĩ ya Kĩhingo gĩa Ithũĩro, na Kĩhingo gĩa Shalekethu mwena wa njĩra ya rũgongo, yagwĩrĩire Shupimu na Hosa. Arangĩri maaikaraga metanĩrĩire.
English: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

Kikuyu: O mũthenya gwakoragwo na Alawii atandatũ mwena wa irathĩro, na Alawii ana mwena wa gathigathini, na Alawii ana mwena wa gũthini, na Alawii eerĩ mahinda mothe nyũmba-inĩ ya kũigwo-indo.
English: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

Kikuyu: Nayo nja ya mwena wa ithũĩro, Alawii ana maikaraga njĩra-inĩ, na Alawii eerĩ maikaraga kũu nja.
English: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

Kikuyu: Icio nĩcio ciarĩ ikundi cia arangĩri a ihingo arĩa maarĩ a njiaro cia Kora na Merari.
English: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

Kikuyu: Alawii arĩa angĩ nĩo maarũgamagĩrĩra igĩĩna cia nyũmba ya Ngai na igĩĩna cia indo iria nyamũre.
English: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Ladani, arĩa maarĩ Agerishoni na ũndũ wa Ladani, na maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia Ladani ũcio Mũgerishoni, maarĩ: Jehieli,
English: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

Kikuyu: na ariũ a Jehieli, na Zethamu, na mũrũ wa nyina Joeli. Acio nĩo maarũgamagĩrĩra igĩĩna cia hekarũ ya Jehova.
English: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Amuramu, na Iziharu, na Hebironi, na Uzieli maarĩ:
English: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

Kikuyu: Shubaeli wa rũciaro rwa Gerishomu mũrũ wa Musa, na nĩwe warĩ mũnene wa kũrũgamĩrĩra igĩĩna.
English: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

Kikuyu: Andũ a nyũmba yao kuuma kũrĩ Eliezeri: maarĩ mũriũ Rehabia, na Jeshia aarĩ mũriũ wa Rehabia, na Joramu aarĩ mũriũ wa Jeshia, na Zikiri aarĩ mũriũ wa Joramu, na Shelomithu aarĩ mũriũ wa Zikiri.
English: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

Kikuyu: Shelomithu na andũ a nyũmba yao nĩo maarũgamagĩrĩra igĩĩna ciothe cia indo iria ciarĩ nyamũre nĩ Mũthamaki Daudi, na indo iria ciarĩ nyamũre nĩ atongoria a nyũmba arĩa maarĩ anene a ikundi cia ngiri ngiri na ikundi cia igana igana, na ikaamũrwo nĩ anene arĩa angĩ a mbũtũ cia ita.
English: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

Kikuyu: Indo imwe cia iria ciatahĩtwo mbaara-inĩ maaciamũrĩire wĩra wa gũcookereria hekarũ ya Jehova.
English: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair Yahweh’s house.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, indo ciothe iria ciaamũrĩtwo nĩ Samũeli ũrĩa muoni-maũndũ, na ikaamũrwo nĩ Saũlũ mũrũ wa Kishu, na Abineri mũrũ wa Neri, na Joabu mũrũ wa Zeruia, na indo iria ingĩ ciothe ciaamũrĩtwo-rĩ, ciamenyagĩrĩrwo nĩ Shelomithu na andũ a nyũmba yao.
English: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Iziharu: Kenania na ariũ ake nĩmaheirwo mawĩra na kũu nja ya hekarũ matuĩke anene na aciirithania a Isiraeli.
English: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Hebironi: maarĩ Hashabia na andũ a nyũmba yao, andũ ehoti 1,700; nĩo maarũgamĩrĩire wĩra wa Jehova wothe kũu Isiraeli mwena wa ithũĩro wa Jorodani, o na wĩra wa gũtungatĩra mũthamaki.
English: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Yahweh and for the service of the king.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Hebironi, Jeria nĩwe warĩ mũnene wao kũringana na maandĩko ma njiarwa cia nyũmba ciao. Mwaka wa mĩrongo ĩna wa ũthamaki wa Daudi nĩ gwatuĩririo maandĩko-inĩ, na gũkĩoneka thĩinĩ wao andũ ehoti o kũu Jazeri ya Gileadi.
English: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

Kikuyu: Jeria aarĩ na andũ a nyũmba yao 2,700 arĩa maarĩ ehoti na maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba, nake Mũthamaki Daudi akĩmatua arũgamĩrĩri a andũ a Rubeni, na a andũ a Gadi, na nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase maũndũ-inĩ mothe marĩa maakonainie na Ngai, o na marĩa maakonainie na ũhoro wa mũthamaki.
English: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

Kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo mũtaratara wa andũ a Isiraeli arĩa maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba, na anene a ikundi cia o ngiri ngiri na ikundi cia o igana igana, na anene ao, arĩa maatungatagĩra mũthamaki maũndũ-inĩ mothe makoniĩ ikundi cia mbũtũ cia ita iria ciakoragwo wĩra-inĩ mweri o mweri, mwaka wothe. O gĩkundi kĩarĩ kĩa andũ 24,000.
English: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũrũgamĩrĩri wa gĩkundi kĩa mbere kĩa mweri wa mbere aarĩ Jashobeamu mũrũ wa Zabidieli. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Nake aarĩ wa rũciaro rwa Perezu, na nĩwe warĩ mũnene wa anene othe a mbũtũ cia ita mweri wa mbere.
English: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

Kikuyu: Mũrũgamĩrĩri wa gĩkundi kĩa mweri wa keerĩ aarĩ Dodai ũrĩa Mũahohi; mũtongoria wa gĩkundi gĩake aarĩ Mikilothu. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa mbũtũ cia ita wa gatatũ, wa mweri wa ĩtatũ aarĩ Benaia mũrũ wa Jehoiada ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai. Nĩwe warĩ mũnene, na gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Benaia ũcio nĩwe warĩ njamba mũno gatagatĩ-inĩ ka arĩa Mĩrongo Ĩtatũ na nĩwe warĩ mũnene wao. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarũgamagĩrĩrwo nĩ mũriũ Amizabadi.
English: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa kana, wa mweri wa ĩna, aarĩ Asaheli mũrũ wa nyina na Joabu; mũriũ Zebadia nĩwe wacookire ithenya rĩake. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa gatano mweri wa ĩtano, aarĩ Shamuhuthu ũrĩa Mũizirahi. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa gatandatũ wa mweri wa ĩtandatũ, aarĩ Ira mũrũ wa Ikeshu ũrĩa Mũtekoa. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa mũgwanja wa mweri wa mũgwanja, aarĩ Helezu ũrĩa Mũpeloni, wa rũciaro rwa Efiraimu. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa kanana, wa mweri wa ĩnana, aarĩ Sibekai ũrĩa Mũhushathi wa rũciaro rwa Azerahi. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa kenda wa mweri wa kenda aarĩ Abiezeri ũrĩa Mũanathothu wa rũciaro rwa Abenjamini. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa ikũmi, wa mweri wa ikũmi, aarĩ Maharai ũrĩa Mũnetofathi wa rũciaro rwa Azerahi. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa ikũmi na ũmwe, wa mweri wa ikũmi na ũmwe, aarĩ Benaia ũrĩa Mũpirathoni wa rũciaro rwa Aefiraimu. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Mũnene wa ikũmi na eerĩ, mweri wa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ, aarĩ Helidai ũrĩa Mũnetofathi, wa kuuma nyũmba ya Othinieli. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
English: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

Kikuyu: Anene arĩa maathaga mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli maarĩ aya: mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Rubeni aarĩ Eliezeri mũrũ wa Zikiri; mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Simeoni aarĩ Shefatia mũrũ wa Maaka;
English: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

Kikuyu: mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Lawi aarĩ Hashabia mũrũ wa Kemueli; mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Harũni aarĩ Zadoku;
English: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

Kikuyu: mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Juda aarĩ Elihu mũrũ wa ithe na Daudi; mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Isakaru aarĩ Omuri mũrũ wa Mikaeli;
English: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

Kikuyu: mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Zebuluni aarĩ Ishimaia mũrũ wa Obadia; mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Nafitali aarĩ Jeremothu mũrũ wa Azirieli;
English: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;

Kikuyu: mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Aefiraimu aarĩ Hoshea mũrũ wa Azazia; mũnene wa nuthu ĩmwe ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase aarĩ Joeli mũrũ wa Pedaia;
English: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

Kikuyu: mũnene wa nuthu ĩrĩa ingĩ ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase kũu Gileadi aarĩ Ido mũrũ wa Zekaria; mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Benjamini aarĩ Jaasieli mũrũ wa Abineri;
English: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

Kikuyu: mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Dani aarĩ Azareli mũrũ wa Jerohamu; Acio nĩo maarĩ anene arĩa maathaga mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli.
English: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

Kikuyu: Daudi ndaatarire andũ a mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na arĩa mataakinyĩtie, tondũ Jehova nĩeranĩire atĩ nĩakaingĩhia Isiraeli matuĩke o ta njata cia matu-inĩ.
English: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

Kikuyu: Joabu mũrũ wa Zeruia nĩambĩrĩirie gũtara andũ, no ndaarĩkirie. Mangʼũrĩ nĩmakinyĩire Isiraeli nĩ ũndũ wa itarana rĩu. Naguo mũigana wa itarana rĩu ndwandĩkirwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa maũndũ ma Mũthamaki Daudi.
English: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

Kikuyu: Azimavethu mũrũ wa Adieli nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra nyũmba iria ciaigagwo indo cia ũthamaki. Jonathani mũrũ wa Uzia nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra nyũmba cia kũigwo indo kũu ngʼongo-inĩ, na matũũra-inĩ, na tũtũũra-inĩ, o na mĩthiringo ĩrĩa mĩraihu na igũrũ ya arangĩri.
English: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

Kikuyu: Eziri mũrũ wa Kelubu nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra andũ arĩa maarutaga wĩra wa kũrĩma mĩgũnda.
English: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.

Kikuyu: Shimei ũrĩa Mũramathi nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra mĩgũnda ya mĩthabibũ. Zabadi ũrĩa Mũshifimi nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra maciaro ma mĩthabibũ matanekĩrwo mĩtũngi-inĩ.
English: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.

Kikuyu: Baali-Hanani ũrĩa Mũgederi nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra mĩtĩ ya mĩtamaiyũ na ya mĩborothandi magũrũ-inĩ ma irĩma cia mwena wa irathĩro. Joashu nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra kũrĩa kwaigagwo maguta ma mĩtamaiyũ.
English: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.

Kikuyu: Shitirai ũrĩa Mũsharoni nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra ndũũru cia ngʼombe iria ciarĩithagio Sharoni. Shafati mũrũ wa Adilai nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra ndũũru cia ngʼombe iria ciarĩ cianda-inĩ.
English: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.

Kikuyu: Obili ũrĩa Mũishumaeli nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra ngamĩĩra. Jehedeia ũrĩa Mũmeronothu nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra ndigiri.
English: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.

Kikuyu: Jazizi ũrĩa Mũhagari nĩwe warũgamagĩrĩra ndũũru cia mbũri. Acio othe nĩo maarĩ anene arĩa marũgamagĩrĩra indo ciothe cia Mũthamaki Daudi.
English: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.

Kikuyu: Jonathani mamawe wa Daudi aarĩ mũheani kĩrĩra, mũndũ mũmenyi maũndũ na mwandĩki- marũa. Nake Jehieli mũrũ wa Hakimoni nĩwe wamenyagĩrĩra ariũ a mũthamaki.
English: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

Kikuyu: Ahithofeli nĩwe waheaga mũthamaki kĩrĩra. Nake Hushai ũrĩa Mũariki aarĩ mũrata wa mũthamaki.
English: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

Kikuyu: Jehoiada mũrũ wa Benaia na Abiatharu nĩo maacookire ithenya rĩa Ahithofeli. Joabu nĩwe warĩ mũnene wa mbũtũ cia ita cia mũthamaki.
English: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

Kikuyu: Daudi nĩatũmanĩire anene othe a Isiraeli moongane Jerusalemu, nao nĩo: anene arĩa maarũgamĩrĩire mĩhĩrĩga, na anene a ikundi iria ciatungatagĩra mũthamaki, na anene a ikundi cia o ngiri ngiri na anene a ikundi cia o igana igana, na anene arĩa maarũgamĩrĩire indo ciothe na mahiũ ma mũthamaki na ma ariũ ake o na anene a nyũmba ya ũthamaki, na andũ arĩa maarĩ njamba, na andũ othe arĩa maarĩ ũrũme wa kũrũa mbaara.
English: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

Kikuyu: Mũthamaki Daudi nĩarũgamire akĩmeera atĩrĩ: “Ta thikĩrĩriai, inyuĩ ariũ a baba na andũ akwa. Nĩndatuĩte na ngoro yakwa gwaka nyũmba ĩtuĩke handũ ha kũhurũkio ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Jehova, arĩ ho gaturwa ka makinya ma Ngai witũ, na ngĩĩhaarĩria kũmĩaka.
English: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

Kikuyu: No Ngai akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Wee ndũgwaka nyũmba ĩtanĩtio na Rĩĩtwa rĩakwa, tondũ wee ũrĩ mũndũ wa mbaara na nĩũitĩte thakame.’
English: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

Kikuyu: “No Jehova, Ngai wa Isiraeli, nĩathuurire kuuma kũrĩ nyũmba iitũ yothe nduĩke mũthamaki wa Isiraeli nginya tene. Nĩathuurire Juda atuĩke mũtongoria, na kuuma nyũmba ya Juda agĩthuura nyũmba ya baba, na kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a baba akĩona kwagĩrĩire aandue niĩ mũthamaki wa Isiraeli yothe.
English: However Yahweh, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

Kikuyu: Harĩ ariũ akwa othe, tondũ Jehova nĩaheete ariũ aingĩ-rĩ, nĩathuurĩte mũriũ wakwa Solomoni aikarĩre gĩtĩ kĩa ũthamaki wa Jehova, athamakĩre Isiraeli.
English: Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh’s kingdom over Israel.

Kikuyu: Aanjĩĩrire atĩrĩ: ‘Mũriũ waku Solomoni nĩwe ũgaaka nyũmba yakwa na nja ciakwa, nĩgũkorwo nĩndĩmũthuurĩte atuĩke mũriũ wakwa na niĩ nduĩke ithe.
English: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

Kikuyu: Nĩngahaanda ũthamaki wake nginya tene angĩtũũra arũmĩtie maathani na mawatho makwa ta ũrĩa kũrekwo ihinda rĩĩrĩ.’
English: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

Kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, rĩu ndamwatha o haha maitho-inĩ ma andũ a Isiraeli othe na kĩũngano gĩkĩ kĩa Jehova, o nake Ngai witũ akĩiguaga: Mũmenyerere, na mũrũmagĩrĩre maathani mothe ma Jehova Ngai wanyu, nĩgeetha mwĩgwatĩre bũrũri ũyũ mwega, na mũkaũtigĩra njiaro cianyu ũtuĩke igai rĩao nginya tene.
English: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, Yahweh’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of Yahweh your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.

Kikuyu: “Nawe mũrũ wakwa Solomoni-rĩ, tũũra ũmenyete Ngai wa thoguo, na ũmũtungatagĩre wĩrutĩire na ngoro yaku yothe na kwĩyendera, nĩgũkorwo Jehova atuĩragia ngoro o yothe, na akamenya gĩtũmi o gĩothe kĩa meciiria ma cio. Ũngĩmũrongooria no ũmuone; no ũngĩmũtirika, agaakũrega nginya tene.
English: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Yahweh searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.

Kikuyu: Gĩĩciirie rĩu, nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩwe athuurĩte wa gwaka hekarũ ĩrĩ handũ hatheru. Gĩa na hinya na ũrute wĩra ũcio.”
English: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Daudi akĩnengera mũriũ Solomoni mĩcoro ya mwako wa gĩthaku kĩa hekarũ, na nyũmba ciayo, na nyũmba cia kũigwo indo, na tũnyũmba twayo twa igũrũ, na tũnyũmba twa thĩinĩ, na handũ ha kũhoroherio mehia.
English: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

Kikuyu: Akĩmũnengera mĩcoro ya mĩako yothe ĩrĩa Roho eekĩrĩte meciiria-inĩ make ĩkoniĩ nja cia hekarũ ya Jehova, na ya tũnyũmba tuothe tũrĩa twamĩthiũrũrũkĩirie na tũnyũmba twa kũigwo igĩĩna cia hekarũ ya Ngai, na gwa kũigwo igĩĩna cia indo iria nyamũre.
English: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

Kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩmũtaarĩria wĩra wa ikundi cia athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na wa Alawii, na wĩra wothe wa ũtungata thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya Jehova, o na wa indo ciothe cia kũhũthagĩrwo ũtungata-inĩ wayo.
English: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—

Kikuyu: Nake akĩheana mũigana wa ũritũ wa thahabu ya gũthondeka indo ciothe cia thahabu cia kũhũthagĩrwo ũtungata-inĩ wa mĩthemba o mĩthemba, na ũritũ wa betha ya gũthondeka indo ciothe cia betha cia kũhũthagĩrwo ũtungata-inĩ wa mĩthemba o mĩthemba, ta ũũ:
English: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

Kikuyu: ũritũ wa thahabu ya gũthondeka mĩtĩ ya thahabu ya kũigĩrĩrwo matawa na matawa mayo, na ũritũ wa o mũtĩ na matawa maguo; na ũritũ wa betha ya gũthondeka o mũtĩ wa betha wa kũigĩrĩra tawa na matawa maguo, kũringana na ũrĩa mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩra matawa wahũthagĩrwo:
English: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

Kikuyu: ũritũ wa thahabu ya gũthondeka metha ya kũigĩrĩra mĩgate ĩrĩa mĩamũre; na ũritũ wa betha ya gũthondeka metha cia betha;
English: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

Kikuyu: na ũritũ wa thahabu therie ya gũthondeka hũũma, na mbakũri cia kũminjaminjĩria, na nyũngũ, ũritũ wa thahabu ya gũthondeka o thaani ya thahabu; na ũritũ wa betha ya gũthondeka o thaani ya betha;
English: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

Kikuyu: na ũritũ wa thahabu therie ya gũthondeka kĩgongona gĩa gũcinĩrwo ũbumba. O na ningĩ akĩmũnengera mũcoro wa ngaari ya ita, ũguo nĩ kuuga ya makerubi ma thahabu marĩa maatambũrũkĩtie mathagu makahumbĩra ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Jehova.
English: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of Yahweh’s covenant.

Kikuyu: Daudi akiuga atĩrĩ, “Maũndũ maya mothe ndĩmandĩkĩte ũrĩa ndatongoririo nĩ guoko kwa Jehova kũrĩ igũrũ rĩakwa, na akĩĩhe ũmenyo wa maũndũ mothe ma mũcoro ũyũ.”
English: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Daudi akĩĩra mũriũ Solomoni atĩrĩ, “Gĩa na hinya na wĩyũmĩrĩrie, na ũrute wĩra ũcio. Ndũgetigĩre na ndũgakue ngoro, tondũ Jehova Ngai, o we Ngai wakwa, arĩ hamwe nawe. Ndagagũtiganĩria kana agũtirike nginya rĩrĩa wĩra wothe ũrĩa ũkaarutwo nĩ ũndũ wa ũtungata wa hekarũ ya Jehova ũgaathira.
English: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for Yahweh God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of Yahweh’s house is finished.

Kikuyu: Ikundi cia athĩnjĩri-Ngai na Alawii, nĩciĩhaarĩrie nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra wothe wa hekarũ ya Ngai, na mũndũ o wothe ũrĩ na wendo na nĩoĩ wĩra wa ũbundi o wothe nĩagagũteithia wĩra-inĩ ũyũ. Anene na andũ othe nĩmarĩathĩkagĩra wathani waku wothe.”
English: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Mũthamaki Daudi akĩĩra kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe atĩrĩ: “Mũriũ wakwa Solomoni, ũrĩa Ngai athuurĩte, nĩ mwĩthĩ na ndarĩ na ũmenyo wa kũigana. Wĩra ũyũ nĩ mũnene, tondũ nyũmba ĩno ĩhaana ta ya ũthamaki ti ya mũndũ no nĩ ya Jehova Ngai.
English: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Yahweh God.

Kikuyu: Nĩnjigithĩtie indo na ũhoti wakwa wothe nĩ ũndũ wa hekarũ ya Ngai wakwa, ngaiga thahabu nĩ ũndũ wa gũthondeka indo cia thahabu, na betha nĩ ũndũ wa gũthondeka indo cia betha, na gĩcango nĩ ũndũ wa gũthondeka indo cia gĩcango, na kĩgera nĩ ũndũ wa gũthondeka indo cia kĩgera, na mbaũ nĩ ũndũ wa gũthondeka indo cia mbaũ, o na tũhiga tũrĩa twĩtagwo onigithi tũrĩa tũtheecagĩrĩrwo indo-inĩ, na tũhiga tũrĩa tũhenagia twa kũgemia nyũmba, na tũhiga twa rangi wa mĩthemba mĩingĩ, na tũhiga twa goro twa mĩthemba mĩingĩ, na mahiga ma nyaigĩ ma mũthemba ũrĩa mwega, indo icio ciothe ngaigithia irĩ nyingĩ mũno.
English: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

Kikuyu: Makĩria ma ũguo, harĩ kwĩrutĩra gwakwa igũrũ rĩa hekarũ ya Ngai wakwa nĩngũheana kĩgĩĩna gĩakwa mwene gĩa thahabu na betha nĩ ũndũ wa hekarũ ya Ngai wakwa, na icio ngũciheana nyongerere kĩrĩa kĩngĩ njigithĩtie nĩ ũndũ wa hekarũ ĩno theru:
English: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:

Kikuyu: ngũheana taranda ngiri ithatũ* cia thahabu, o thahabu ĩrĩa ya Ofiri, na taranda ngiri mũgwanja† cia betha ĩrĩa therie nĩ ũndũ wa kũgemia thingo cia nyũmba,
English: even three thousand talents of gold,† of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents‡ of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;

Kikuyu: o na nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra wa thahabu na indo cia wĩra wa betha ũrĩa wothe ũkaarutwo nĩ mabundi. Na rĩrĩ, nũũ ũkwĩĩamũrĩra Jehova ũmũthĩ na kwĩyendera?”
English: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to Yahweh?”

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo atongoria a nyũmba, na anene a mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli, na anene a ikundi cia ngiri ngiri na anene a ikundi cia igana igana na anene arĩa maarũgamagĩrĩra wĩra wa mũthamaki makĩheana indo na kwĩyendera.
English: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra wa hekarũ ya Ngai nĩmaheanire taranda ngiri ithano,‡ na dariki ngiri ikũmi§ cia thahabu, na taranda ngiri ikũmi* cia betha, na taranda ngiri ikũmi na inyanya† cia gĩcango, na taranda ngiri igana rĩmwe‡ cia kĩgera.
English: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents§ and ten thousand darics,† of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.

Kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe warĩ na tũhiga twa goro nĩatũheanire thĩinĩ wa kĩgĩĩna kĩa hekarũ ya Jehova kĩrĩa kĩamenyagĩrĩrwo nĩ Jehieli ũrĩa Mũgerishoni.
English: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of Yahweh’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

Kikuyu: Andũ nĩmakenirio nĩ ũrĩa atongoria ao maamũkĩire ũhoro ũcio na kwĩyendera, tondũ nĩmarutĩire Jehova indo na ngoro yao yothe matekũringĩrĩrio. Mũthamaki Daudi o nake nĩakenire mũno.
English: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to Yahweh; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

Kikuyu: Daudi nĩagoocire Jehova arĩ mbere ya kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũrogoocwo wee, o Wee Jehova, Ngai wa ithe witũ Isiraeli, kuuma tene nginya tene.
English: Therefore David blessed Yahweh before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, Yahweh, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

Kikuyu: Wee Jehova-rĩ, ũnene, na hinya, na riiri, na wathani, na ũkengi nĩ ciaku, nĩgũkorwo kĩndũ o gĩothe kĩrĩ igũrũ na thĩ nĩ gĩaku. Wee Jehova, ũthamaki nĩ waku; nĩũtũũgĩrĩtio, ũkanenehio gũkĩra indo ciothe.
English: Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.

Kikuyu: Ũtonga na gĩtĩĩo ciumaga kũrĩ we; Wee nĩwe wathaga indo ciothe. Hinya na ũhoti wa gũtũũgĩria o na kũhe andũ othe hinya irĩ moko-inĩ maku.
English: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Ngai witũ, nĩtũgũgũcookeria ngaatho, na tũkagooca rĩĩtwa rĩaku rĩrĩ riiri.
English: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

Kikuyu: “No niĩ ngĩrĩ ũ, nao andũ akwa-rĩ, makĩrĩ a, atĩ no tũhote kũheana na ũtaana ta ũyũ? Indo ciothe ciumaga kũrĩ we, na kĩrĩa twakũhe no kĩrĩa kiumĩte moko-inĩ maku.
English: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

Kikuyu: Ithuĩ tũrĩ ageni na agendi maitho-inĩ maku, o ta ũrĩa maithe maitũ ma tene othe maatariĩ. Matukũ maitũ gũkũ thĩ matariĩ o ta kĩĩruru, na gũtirĩ mwĩhoko wa gũtũũra.
English: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.

Kikuyu: Wee Jehova Ngai witũ, ũingĩ wa indo ici twaruta cia gũgwakĩra hekarũ nĩ ũndũ wa Rĩĩtwa rĩaku Itheru ciumĩte guoko-inĩ gwaku, na ciothe no ciaku.
English: Yahweh our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.

Kikuyu: Niĩ nĩnjũũĩ atĩ Wee Ngai wakwa nĩũtuĩragia ngoro, na nĩũkenagio nĩ ũrũngĩrĩru wa ngoro. Indo ici ciothe ndĩciheanĩte na kwĩyendera na wĩhokeku. Na rĩu ndĩ na gĩkeno nĩ ũndũ wa kwĩonera ũrĩa andũ aya aku marĩ haha makũrutĩire indo na wendo.
English: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

Kikuyu: Wee Jehova, Ngai wa maithe maitũ Iburahĩmu, na Isaaka na Isiraeli, tũũria wendo ũyũ ũrĩ ngoro-inĩ cia andũ aku nginya tene na ũtũme matũũre magwathĩkagĩra.
English: Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;

Kikuyu: Na ũhotithie mũriũ wakwa Solomoni kwĩrutĩra na ngoro yake yothe, kũmenyagĩrĩra maathani maku, na maũndũ marĩa wee wendaga o na kĩrĩra gĩaku kĩa watho wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo, na ekage maũndũ mothe nĩguo aake mwako wa nyũmba ĩno ĩhaana ta nyũmba ya ũthamaki, ĩrĩa niĩ njigithĩirie indo ciayo.”
English: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Daudi akĩĩra kĩũngano gĩothe atĩrĩ, “Goocai Jehova Ngai wanyu.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ othe makĩgooca Jehova Ngai wa maithe mao; makĩinamĩrĩra, na makĩĩgũithia thĩ mbere ya Jehova na mbere ya mũthamaki.
English: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless Yahweh your God!” All the assembly blessed Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before Yahweh and the king.

Kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ makĩrutĩra Jehova magongona na makĩmũrutĩra maruta ma njino, ta ũũ: ndegwa ngiri ĩmwe, na ndũrũme ngiri ĩmwe na tũtũrũme ngiri ĩmwe, o hamwe na maruta mao ma indo cia kũnyuuo na magongona mangĩ maingĩ nĩ ũndũ wa andũ a Isiraeli othe.
English: They sacrificed sacrifices to Yahweh and offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,

Kikuyu: Makĩrĩa na makĩnyua marĩ na gĩkeno kĩnene mũthenya ũcio marĩ hau mbere ya Jehova. Ningĩ makĩamũkĩra Solomoni mũrũ wa Daudi arĩ mũthamaki hĩndĩ ya keerĩ, na makĩmũitĩrĩria maguta mbere ya Jehova atuĩke wa kũmathamakĩra, nake Zadoku atuĩke mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: and ate and drank before Yahweh on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before Yahweh to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Solomoni agĩikarĩra gĩtĩ gĩa ũthamaki kĩa Jehova, na agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩa ithe Daudi. Nake akĩgaacĩra na agĩathĩkĩrwo Isiraeli guothe.
English: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Yahweh as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

Kikuyu: Anene othe, na andũ arĩa maarĩ njamba, hamwe na ariũ a Mũthamaki Daudi othe magĩtĩkĩra Mũthamaki Solomoni amaathage.
English: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

Kikuyu: Jehova agĩtũũgĩria Solomoni mũno maitho-inĩ ma andũ a Isiraeli othe, na akĩmũhe ũthamaki ũrĩ na riiri ũtaahetwo mũthamaki ũngĩ wa Isiraeli mbere ĩyo.
English: Yahweh magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

Kikuyu: Daudi mũrũ wa Jesii aarĩ mũthamaki wa Isiraeli guothe.
English: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

Kikuyu: Aathamakĩire Isiraeli mĩaka mĩrongo ĩna, mĩaka mũgwanja yayo agĩthamaka arĩ Hebironi, nayo mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ĩtatũ agĩthamaka arĩ Jerusalemu.
English: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

Kikuyu: Aakuire arĩ mũkũrũ mũno, arĩkĩtie gũkenera gũtũũra gwake matukũ maingĩ, na arĩ mũtongu, na agatĩĩo. Mũriũ Solomoni nĩwe wathamakire ithenya rĩake.
English: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.

Kikuyu: Naho ha maũndũ marĩa makoniĩ wathani wa Mũthamaki Daudi kuuma kĩambĩrĩria nginya mũthia, nĩmandĩkĩtwo thĩinĩ wa maandĩko ma Samũeli ũrĩa warĩ muoni-maũndũ, na maandĩko-inĩ ma Nathani ũrĩa mũnabii na maandĩko-inĩ ma Gadi ũrĩa muoni-maũndũ,
English: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

Kikuyu: hamwe na maũndũ mothe marĩa maakoniĩ ũthamaki wake na ũhoti ũrĩa aarĩ naguo, na ũrĩa maũndũ marĩa maamũthiũrũrũkĩirie maatariĩ na ma Isiraeli na mothamaki ma mabũrũri marĩa mangĩ mothe.
English: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.
